fci-scottish-terrier-official-standard.name: FCI - Scottish Terrier Official Breed Standard No. 73
fci-scottish-terrier-official-standard.note: Official English FCI Standard No. 73 (valid standard dated 2026-09-08, published 2026-10-06). Covers Great Britain origin, Group 3 Terriers, Section 2 Small-sized Terriers classification without working trial, harsh double coat, black/wheaten/brindle colors, height (25–28 cm), and weight (8.5–10.5 kg).

fci-scottish-terrier-nomenclature.name: FCI - Scottish Terrier Breed Nomenclature (No. 73)
fci-scottish-terrier-nomenclature.note: Official FCI breed nomenclature record confirming Great Britain as country of origin, Group 3 Section 2 Small-sized Terriers without working trial, definitive recognition date (1954-10-18), valid standard date (2026-09-08), and multilingual names (Scottish Terrier, Terrier Ecossais, Schottischer Terrier).

the-kennel-club-scottish-terrier-breed-s.name: The Royal Kennel Club - Scottish Terrier Breed Standard
the-kennel-club-scottish-terrier-breed-s.note: Official Royal Kennel Club breed standard (Terrier Group, last updated 2025-01-01) establishing height at withers (25–28 cm / 10–11 ins), weight (8.5–10.5 kg / 19–23 lbs), close-lying harsh wiry double coat, black/wheaten/brindle colors, regular scissor bite, and bold, never aggressive temperament.

akc-scottish-terrier-breed-standard.name: American Kennel Club - Official Standard of the Scottish Terrier
akc-scottish-terrier-breed-standard.note: Official AKC breed standard establishing height of about 10 inches at the withers, weight of 19 to 22 pounds for males and 18 to 21 pounds for females, thick-set substance, large teeth, scissor or level bite, and distinctive coat furnishings.

akc-scottish-terrier-breed-profile.name: American Kennel Club - Scottish Terrier Dog Breed Information
akc-scottish-terrier-breed-profile.note: Official AKC breed profile (Terrier Group, recognized 1885) listing height (10 inches), weight (19–22 pounds male, 18–21 pounds female), life expectancy (12 years), grooming (hand-stripping vs. 6–8 week clipping), training (sessions under 15 minutes), nutrition, recommended tests (Patella, vWD III DNA, CMO), and historical lore (Fala, Caacie, Telek, 1860 first show class).

scottish-terrier-club-of-america-health.name: Scottish Terrier Club of America - Health
scottish-terrier-club-of-america-health.note: Official STCA health portal detailing updated CHIC requirements effective January 1, 2025: required vWD DNA, CMO DNA, and Patellar Luxation evaluation, plus elective options (Autoimmune Thyroiditis panel, ACVO Eye Exam, Serum Bile Acid test, Kidney UPC screen, and Legg-Calvé-Perthes radiographs).

ofa-scottish-terrier-chic-requirements.name: Orthopedic Foundation for Animals - Scottish Terrier CHIC Requirements
ofa-scottish-terrier-chic-requirements.note: Official OFA Canine Health Information Center (CHIC) testing requirements for the Scottish Terrier, mandating DNA testing for von Willebrand's Disease (vWD Type III), clinical patellar luxation evaluation, and CAER eye examination.

scottish-terrier-bladder-cancer-study-20.name: Evaluation of the Association Between Dietary Intake of Vegetables and Risk of Urothelial Carcinoma in Scottish Terriers (JAVMA 2005)
scottish-terrier-bladder-cancer-study-20.note: Peer-reviewed scientific study (Raghavan et al., J Am Vet Med Assoc 2005;227(1):94-100, PMID 16013542) evaluating risk factors and demonstrating that consumption of green leafy and yellow-orange vegetables is associated with a significantly reduced risk of transitional cell carcinoma in Scottish Terriers.

fci-briard-official-standard.name: FCI - Briard (Berger de Brie) Official Breed Standard No. 113
fci-briard-official-standard.note: Official English FCI Standard No. 113 (valid standard dated 2008-11-04, published 2009-01-23). Covers French origin, Group 1 Sheepdogs and Cattledogs, Section 1 Sheepdogs classification with working trial, rectangular build, long dry goat-hair coat, double dewclaws on rear limbs, J-shaped tail crochet, and withers height (males 62-68 cm, females 56-64 cm).

fci-briard-nomenclature.name: FCI - Berger de Brie (Briard) Breed Nomenclature (No. 113)
fci-briard-nomenclature.note: Official FCI breed nomenclature record confirming France as country of origin, Group 1 Section 1 Sheepdogs with working trial, definitive recognition date (1954-12-14), valid standard date (2008-11-04), and official names (Berger de Brie, Briard).

scc-briard-breed-standard.name: Société Centrale Canine - Berger de Brie
scc-briard-breed-standard.note: Official French kennel club (SCC) breed profile for the Berger de Brie detailing 1809 naming, 1897 goat-hair vs. woolly standard history, height (56–68 cm), goat-like coat, and behavior/city living guidance.

club-du-chien-de-brie-profile.name: Société Centrale Canine - Dossier Le Berger de Brie
club-du-chien-de-brie-profile.note: Official SCC breed dossier on the Berger de Brie covering rural pastoral history, character and working functionality, and standard commentary.

akc-briard-breed-standard.name: American Kennel Club - Official Standard of the Briard
akc-briard-breed-standard.note: Official AKC breed standard (Herding Group) establishing height (males 23 to 27 inches, females 22 to 25.5 inches), rectangular proportions, mandatory double dewclaws on hind legs, goat-like coat texture, J-tail, and herding temperament.

akc-briard-breed-profile.name: American Kennel Club - Briard Dog Breed Information
akc-briard-breed-profile.note: Official AKC breed profile (Herding Group, recognized 1928) listing height (23–27 inches male, 22–25.5 inches female), weight (55–100 pounds), life expectancy (12 years), grooming, exercise, training, nutrition, health conditions, and recommended tests (Hip, Ophthalmologist, CSNB DNA).

the-kennel-club-briard-breed-standard.name: The Royal Kennel Club - Briard Breed Standard
the-kennel-club-briard-breed-standard.note: Official Royal Kennel Club breed standard (Pastoral Group, updated 2025-08-01) detailing rugged, supple conformation, dark brown horizontal eyes, complete scissor bite, double dewclaws, and goat-like coat.

ukc-briard-breed-standard.name: United Kennel Club - Briard Breed Standard
ukc-briard-breed-standard.note: Official UKC breed standard (Herding Dog Group, recognized 1948) covering conformation, double dewclaws, goat-hair coat, and flock guardian behavior.

ofa-briard-chic-requirements.name: Orthopedic Foundation for Animals - Briard CHIC Requirements
ofa-briard-chic-requirements.note: Official OFA Canine Health Information Center (CHIC) testing requirements for the Briard, mandating radiographic hip dysplasia evaluation, CAER eye examination, and DNA testing for Congenital Stationary Night Blindness (CSNB).

briard-csnb-rpe65-study-1998.name: Congenital Stationary Night Blindness in the Dog: Common Mutation in the RPE65 Gene Indicates Founder Effect (Mol Vis 1998)
briard-csnb-rpe65-study-1998.note: Peer-reviewed molecular genetics study (Aguirre et al., Mol Vis 1998 Oct 30;4:23, PMID 9808841) identifying the homozygous 4-nucleotide (AAGA) deletion in canine RPE65 (nucleotides 487–490) causing congenital stationary night blindness and retinal dystrophy in Briards.

fci-weimaraner-official-standard.name: FCI - Weimaraner Official Breed Standard No. 99
fci-weimaraner-official-standard.note: Official English FCI Standard No. 99 (valid standard dated 2015-03-19, published 2015-05-26). Covers German origin, Group 7 Pointing Dogs, Section 1.1 Continental Pointing Dogs, Type Braque classification with working trial, short-haired and long-haired varieties, silver/roe/mouse grey coloration, withers height (males 59-70 cm, females 57-65 cm), and weight (males 30-40 kg, females 25-35 kg).

fci-weimaraner-nomenclature.name: FCI - Weimaraner Breed Nomenclature (No. 99)
fci-weimaraner-nomenclature.note: Official FCI breed nomenclature record confirming Germany as country of origin, Group 7 Section 1.1 Continental Pointing Dogs (Type Braque) with working trial, definitive recognition date (1954-11-27), and multilingual names (Weimaraner, Braque de Weimar).

vdh-weimaraner-breed-standard.name: Verband für das Deutsche Hundewesen - Rasselexikon Weimaraner (FCI 99)

weimaraner-klub-ev-breed-profile.name: Weimaraner Klub e.V. - Rasseportrait und Geschichte
weimaraner-klub-ev-breed-profile.note: Official German parent breed club portal documenting the 1897 club founding in Erfurt, Grand Ducal Court of Weimar breeding, selective hunter-only distribution history, working trials, and health requirements.

akc-weimaraner-breed-standard.name: American Kennel Club - Official Standard of the Weimaraner
akc-weimaraner-breed-standard.note: Official AKC breed standard (effective December 14, 1971, Sporting Group) establishing height (males 25 to 27 inches, females 23 to 25 inches), sleek gray coat, light amber/gray eyes, scissor bite, and versatile pointing temperament.

akc-weimaraner-breed-profile.name: American Kennel Club - Weimaraner Dog Breed Information
akc-weimaraner-breed-profile.note: Official AKC breed profile (Sporting Group, recognized 1943) listing height (25–27 inches male, 23–25 inches female), weight (70–90 pounds male, 55–75 pounds female), life expectancy (10–13 years), gastric torsion risk, recommended tests (Hip, Cardiac, Ophthalmologist, Thyroid, SD DNA, HYM DNA, HUU DNA), and cultural history (Eisenhower's Heidi, William Wegman).

the-kennel-club-weimaraner-breed-standar.name: The Royal Kennel Club - Weimaraner Breed Standard
the-kennel-club-weimaraner-breed-standar.note: Official Royal Kennel Club breed standard (Gundog Group, updated 2025-08-01) detailing medium-sized grey appearance, amber or blue-grey eyes, smooth and long-haired (2.5–5 cm) coat varieties, compact feet, and fearless, friendly, obedient temperament.

ukc-weimaraner-breed-standard.name: United Kennel Club - Weimaraner Breed Standard
ukc-weimaraner-breed-standard.note: Official UKC breed standard (Gun Dog Group, recognized 1949, revised 2014) covering conformation, rectangular proportions, short and long coat varieties, and versatile hunting behavior.

weimaraner-club-of-america-health.name: Weimaraner Club of America - Canine Health Information Center (CHIC) & Research
weimaraner-club-of-america-health.note: Official Weimaraner Club of America health and CHIC portal documenting DNA banking (UC Davis / University of Missouri), CHIC screening, and WCA-supported research on hypertrophic osteodystrophy (HOD), panosteitis, spinal dysraphism, hypomyelination, and hyperuricosuria.

ofa-weimaraner-chic-requirements.name: Orthopedic Foundation for Animals - Weimaraner CHIC Requirements
ofa-weimaraner-chic-requirements.note: Official OFA Canine Health Information Center (CHIC) testing requirements for the Weimaraner, mandating radiographic hip dysplasia evaluation, CAER eye examination, and autoimmune thyroiditis blood profile, alongside optional spinal dysraphism DNA test and elbow evaluation.

fci-curly-coated-retriever-official-stan.name: FCI - Curly Coated Retriever Official Breed Standard No. 110
fci-curly-coated-retriever-official-stan.note: Official English FCI Standard No. 110 (valid standard dated 2026-09-08, published 2026-10-06). fci-curly-coated-retriever-nomenclature.name: FCI - Curly Coated Retriever Breed Nomenclature (No. 110)
fci-curly-coated-retriever-nomenclature.note: Official FCI breed nomenclature record confirming Great Britain as country of origin, Group 8 Section 1 classification with working trial, definitive recognition date (1954-12-10), valid official standard date (2026-09-08), and multilingual names.

the-kennel-club-curly-coated-retriever-b.name: The Royal Kennel Club - Curly Coated Retriever Breed Standard
the-kennel-club-curly-coated-retriever-b.note: Official Royal Kennel Club breed standard (Gundog Group, country of origin standard) establishing ideal withers height (dogs 69 cm / 27 in, bitches 64 cm / 25 in), oval obliquely set eyes, crisp tight curls without undercoat, black and liver colors, and steady retrieving temperament.

akc-curly-coated-retriever-breed-standar.name: American Kennel Club - Official Standard of the Curly-Coated Retriever
akc-curly-coated-retriever-breed-standar.note: Official AKC breed standard (effective November 28, 1994, Sporting Group) establishing height (dogs 25 to 27 inches, bitches 23 to 25 inches), proportions, tight crisp water-repellent curls, black and liver colors, and retrieving drive.

akc-curly-coated-retriever-breed-profile.name: American Kennel Club - Curly-Coated Retriever Dog Breed Information
akc-curly-coated-retriever-breed-profile.note: Official AKC breed profile covering British history (1860 Birmingham show debut, 1889 export to New Zealand and Australia, 1896 English club, 1924 AKC recognition), weight (60-95 pounds), lifespan (10-12 years), grooming (no brushing, wet and air-dry), alone-time sensitivity, and recommended health tests (hips, cardiac, ophthalmologist, crd4/cord1 PRA DNA, EIC DNA, GSDIIIa DNA).

curly-coated-retriever-club-of-america-h.name: Curly-Coated Retriever Club of America - Health
curly-coated-retriever-club-of-america-h.note: Official national parent club health portal covering autosomal recessive Glycogen Storage Disease Type IIIa (GSD IIIa, DNA test developed with Dr. John C. Fyfe at Michigan State University), bloat (GDV) survey tracking, and canine epilepsy research.

ofa-curly-coated-retriever-chic-requirem.name: Orthopedic Foundation for Animals - Curly-Coated Retriever CHIC Requirements
ofa-curly-coated-retriever-chic-requirem.note: Official OFA Canine Health Information Center (CHIC) testing requirements for the Curly-Coated Retriever covering radiographic hip evaluation, CAER eye examination, cardiac evaluation, and DNA testing for Exercise-Induced Collapse (EIC), Glycogen Storage Disease Type IIIa (GSD IIIa), and Cone-Rod Dystrophy (crd4/cord1 PRA).

fci-spanish-mastiff-official-standard.note: Official English FCI Standard No. 91 (original valid standard dated 1982-05-26, published 2002-08-30). fci-spanish-mastiff-nomenclature.name: FCI - Spanish Mastiff Breed Nomenclature (No. 91)

fci-norrbottenspets-official-standard.note: Official English FCI Standard No. 276 (valid standard dated 2009-07-28, published 2009-10-21). fci-norrbottenspets-nomenclature.name: FCI - Norrbottenspets Breed Nomenclature (No. 276)

skk-norrbottenspets-breed-standard.name: Svenska Kennelklubben - Norrbottenspets Breed Profile & Standard

fci-rhodesian-ridgeback-official-standar.name: FCI - Rhodesian Ridgeback Official Breed Standard No. 146
fci-rhodesian-ridgeback-official-standar.note: Official English FCI Standard No. 146 (valid standard dated 2025-05-15, published 2025-06-06; supplied by KUSA and Zimbabwe Kennel Club). Covers Southern Africa origin, Group 6 Section 3 Related breeds without working trial, 1922 Bulawayo Dalmatian-based standard, symmetrical dorsal ridge with two opposite crowns, wheaten shades, withers height (males 63-69 cm, females 61-66 cm), and published weight (males 36.5 kg, females 32 kg).

fci-rhodesian-ridgeback-nomenclature.name: FCI - Rhodesian Ridgeback Breed Nomenclature (No. 146)
fci-rhodesian-ridgeback-nomenclature.note: Official FCI breed nomenclature record confirming South Africa as country of origin, Group 6 Section 3 classification without working trial, definitive recognition date (1955-02-21), valid official standard date (2025-05-15), publication date (2025-06-06), and multilingual names (Chien de Rhodésie à Crête Dorsale, Perro Crestado Rodesiano).

kusa-rhodesian-ridgeback-breed-standard.name: Kennel Union of Southern Africa - Rhodesian Ridgeback Breed Standard
kusa-rhodesian-ridgeback-breed-standard.note: Official Kennel Union of Southern Africa (KUSA) breed standard for the Rhodesian Ridgeback (co-supplied with Zimbabwe Kennel Club to FCI), covering southern African origin, height (63-69 cm dogs, 61-66 cm bitches), weight (36.5 kg dogs, 32 kg bitches), and ridge requirements.

akc-rhodesian-ridgeback-breed-standard.name: American Kennel Club - Official Standard of the Rhodesian Ridgeback
akc-rhodesian-ridgeback-breed-standard.note: Official AKC breed standard (effective June 9, 1992, Hound Group) establishing height (males 25 to 27 inches, females 24 to 26 inches), weight (85 lbs dogs, 70 lbs bitches), symmetrical ridge with two crowns, scissor bite, and wheaten coat colors.

akc-rhodesian-ridgeback-breed-profile.name: American Kennel Club - Rhodesian Ridgeback Dog Breed Information
akc-rhodesian-ridgeback-breed-profile.note: Official AKC breed profile (recognized 1955, Hound Group) covering southern African Khoikhoi/Boer/van Rooyen history, Errol Flynn 1930s breeding, height (25-27 in / 24-26 in), weight (85 / 70 lbs), lifespan (10-12 years), wheaten colors with black or brown nose, counter-surfing note, nail grinder tip, and recommended breed club health tests (Hip Evaluation, Elbow Evaluation; plus thyroid, eye, and dermoid sinus screening).

the-kennel-club-rhodesian-ridgeback-bree.name: The Royal Kennel Club - Rhodesian Ridgeback Breed Standard
the-kennel-club-rhodesian-ridgeback-bree.note: Official Royal Kennel Club breed standard (Hound Group, updated 2025-04-01) confirming height (dogs 63-69 cm, bitches 61-66 cm), weight (dogs 36.5 kg, bitches 32 kg), round bright eyes harmonising with coat, symmetrical ridge, and hunting temperament.

ukc-rhodesian-ridgeback-breed-standard.name: United Kennel Club - Rhodesian Ridgeback Breed Standard
ukc-rhodesian-ridgeback-breed-standard.note: United Kennel Club Sighthound & Pariah Dog Group standard reference retained from catalog registry; primary verification conducted via FCI Standard No. 146 (2025), Royal Kennel Club, AKC, and PubMed.

rrcus-rhodesian-ridgeback-health-survey.name: Rhodesian Ridgeback Club of the United States - Health, Genetics, and Dermoid Sinus
rrcus-rhodesian-ridgeback-health-survey.note: Official national parent club health portal covering dermoid sinus palpation, degenerative myelopathy (DM), juvenile myoclonic epilepsy (JME), early onset adult deafness (EOAD), thyroiditis, and pre-breeding health testing guidelines.
rrcus-rhodesian-ridgeback-health-survey.publisher: Rhodesian Ridgeback Club of the United States

ofa-rhodesian-ridgeback-chic-requirement.name: Orthopedic Foundation for Animals - Rhodesian Ridgeback CHIC Requirements
ofa-rhodesian-ridgeback-chic-requirement.note: Official OFA Canine Health Information Center (CHIC) testing requirements for the Rhodesian Ridgeback covering hip dysplasia, elbow dysplasia, CAER eye examination, autoimmune thyroiditis, and DNA screening options.

rhodesian-ridgeback-dermoid-sinus-study-.name: Salmon Hillbertz et al. (2007) - Duplication of FGF3, FGF4, FGF19 and ORAOV1 causes hair ridge and predisposes to dermoid sinus in Ridgeback dogs
rhodesian-ridgeback-dermoid-sinus-study-.note: Peer-reviewed study in Nature Genetics (2007;39(11):1318-1320, PMID 17922012) establishing that a 133-kb duplication involving FGF3, FGF4, FGF19, and ORAOV1 creates the dorsal hair ridge and predisposes Rhodesian Ridgebacks to congenital dermoid sinus.

fci-whippet-official-standard.name: FCI - Whippet Official Breed Standard No. 162
fci-whippet-official-standard.note: Official English FCI Standard No. 162 (valid standard dated 2026-09-08, English edition published 2026-10-06). Covers Great Britain origin, Group 10 Sighthounds, Section 3 Short-haired Sighthounds classification without working trial, arch over loin, rose ears, withers height (males 47-51 cm, females 44-47 cm), and coat color (any color or mixture except merle).

fci-whippet-nomenclature.name: FCI - Whippet Breed Nomenclature (No. 162)
fci-whippet-nomenclature.note: Official FCI breed nomenclature record confirming Great Britain as country of origin, Group 10 Section 3 classification without working trial, definitive recognition date (1955-04-27), valid standard dated 2026-09-08, and multilingual names (Lévrier Whippet).

the-kennel-club-whippet-breed-standard.name: The Royal Kennel Club - Whippet Breed Standard
the-kennel-club-whippet-breed-standard.note: Official Royal Kennel Club breed standard (Hound Group, country of origin standard) establishing withers height (dogs 47-51 cm; bitches 44-47 cm), fine close coat, rose ears, and sighthound conformation.

akc-whippet-breed-standard.name: American Kennel Club - Official Standard of the Whippet
akc-whippet-breed-standard.note: Official AKC breed standard (Hound Group) establishing height (dogs 19 to 22 inches, bitches 18 to 21 inches), proportions, rose ears, scissor bite, and color specifications.

akc-whippet-breed-profile.name: American Kennel Club - Whippet Dog Breed Information
akc-whippet-breed-profile.note: Official AKC breed profile covering English mining history, snap dog and rag racing roots, speed (up to 35 mph), published weight (25-40 lbs), lifespan (12-15 years), temperament, and grooming.

american-whippet-club-health.name: American Whippet Club - Health and Genetics
american-whippet-club-health.note: Official national parent club health portal covering sighthound anesthesia sensitivity, cardiac health (mitral valve disease, athletic heart), myostatin mutation testing, and pre-breeding health screening guidelines.

ofa-whippet-chic-requirements.name: Orthopedic Foundation for Animals - Whippet CHIC Requirements
ofa-whippet-chic-requirements.note: Official OFA Canine Health Information Center (CHIC) testing requirements for the Whippet, mandating CAER eye examination, congenital cardiac evaluation by a specialist, and autoimmune thyroiditis blood panel.

whippet-myostatin-mutation-study-2007.name: A Mutation in the Myostatin Gene Increases Muscle Mass and Enhances Racing Performance in Heterozygote Dogs (PLoS Genetics 2007)
whippet-myostatin-mutation-study-2007.note: Peer-reviewed scientific study (Mosher et al., PLoS Genet 2007;3(5):e79, PMID 17530926) identifying a 2-bp deletion in the myostatin (MSTN) gene that enhances racing performance in heterozygous Whippets and causes severe muscular hypertrophy ('bully whippets') in homozygotes.

societe-centrale-canine-ariegeois.name: Société Centrale Canine — Ariegeois Breed Profile
societe-centrale-canine-ariegeois.note: National French kennel club breed profile covering history, Pyrenean origin, hunting application, calm temperament, care, height (50–58 cm), and unrecorded formal weight ('Poids: NP').

fci-fox-terrier-smooth-official-standard.name: FCI - Fox Terrier (Smooth) Official Breed Standard No. 12
fci-fox-terrier-smooth-official-standard.note: Official English FCI Standard No. 12 (valid standard dated 2026-09-08, English edition published 2026-10-06). Covers Great Britain origin, Group 3 Terriers, Section 1 Large and medium-sized Terriers with optional working trial, flat hard smooth coat, white-predominated coloration (brindle, red, or liver markings highly undesirable; other colours unacceptable), withers height not exceeding 39 cm in males (females slightly less), and weight (dogs 7.5-8 kg, bitches 7-7.5 kg).

fci-fox-terrier-smooth-nomenclature.name: FCI - Fox Terrier (Smooth) Breed Nomenclature (No. 12)
fci-fox-terrier-smooth-nomenclature.note: Official FCI breed nomenclature record confirming Great Britain as country of origin, Group 3 Section 1 classification (subject to a working trial only for countries having applied for it), definitive FCI acceptance date (1963-06-26), valid standard dated 2026-09-08, and multilingual names.

the-kennel-club-fox-terrier-smooth-breed.name: The Royal Kennel Club - Fox Terrier (Smooth) Breed Standard
the-kennel-club-fox-terrier-smooth-breed.note: Official Royal Kennel Club breed standard (Terrier Group, country of origin standard) establishing general appearance, straight flat smooth coat, V-shaped drop ears, scissor bite, and fearless sporting temperament.

akc-smooth-fox-terrier-breed-standard.name: American Kennel Club - Official Standard of the Smooth Fox Terrier
akc-smooth-fox-terrier-breed-standard.note: Official AKC breed standard (Terrier Group) establishing height not to exceed 15.5 inches for males, proportions, smooth flat coat, V-shaped drop ears, scissor bite, and alert terrier carriage.

akc-smooth-fox-terrier-breed-profile.name: American Kennel Club - Smooth Fox Terrier Dog Breed Information
akc-smooth-fox-terrier-breed-profile.note: Official AKC breed profile covering English fox-hunting history, three-time Westminster winner Ch. Warren Remedy, Herbert Hoover dogs, weight (15-18 lbs), lifespan (12-15 years), temperament, and care.

ukc-smooth-fox-terrier-breed-standard.name: United Kennel Club - Smooth Fox Terrier Breed Standard
ukc-smooth-fox-terrier-breed-standard.note: Official UKC breed standard (Terrier Group, recognized 1912) covering conformation, rectangular proportions, smooth coat, height, weight, and working earthdog behavior.

ofa-smooth-fox-terrier-chic-requirements.name: Orthopedic Foundation for Animals - Smooth Fox Terrier CHIC Requirements
ofa-smooth-fox-terrier-chic-requirements.note: Official OFA Canine Health Information Center (CHIC) testing requirements for the Smooth Fox Terrier, mandating clinical patellar luxation evaluation, CAER eye examination, congenital cardiac evaluation, and DNA testing for Primary Lens Luxation (PLL) and Spinocerebellar Ataxia (SCA).

smooth-fox-terrier-sca-kcnj10-study-2014.name: A Homozygous KCNJ10 Mutation in Jack Russell Terriers and Related Breeds with Spinocerebellar Ataxia with Myokymia, Seizures, or Both (J Vet Intern Med 2014)
smooth-fox-terrier-sca-kcnj10-study-2014.note: Peer-reviewed scientific study (Gilliam et al., J Vet Intern Med 2014;28(3):871-877, PMID 24708069) identifying the homozygous KCNJ10:c.627C>G missense mutation responsible for autosomal recessive spinocerebellar ataxia with myokymia, seizures, or both in Russell-group and related terriers.
smooth-fox-terrier-sca-kcnj10-study-2014.publisher: Journal of Veterinary Internal Medicine / PubMed Central

fci-bolognese-official-standard.name: FCI - Bolognese Official Breed Standard No. 196
fci-bolognese-official-standard.note: Official English FCI Standard No. 196 (valid standard dated 2015-11-13, published 2015-12-17). Covers Italian origin in Bologna, Group 9 Companion and Toy Dogs, Section 1 Bichons and related breeds classification without working trial, square proportions (height equals length), pure white flocky coat in tufts without fringes, withers height (males 27-30 cm, females 25-28 cm), and weight (2.5 to 4 kg).

fci-bolognese-nomenclature.name: FCI - Bolognese Breed Nomenclature (No. 196)
fci-bolognese-nomenclature.note: Official FCI breed nomenclature record confirming Italy as country of origin, Group 9 Section 1 classification without working trial, definitive recognition date (1956-03-05), and multilingual names (Bolognese, Bologneser).

enci-bolognese-breed-standard.name: Ente Nazionale della Cinofilia Italiana - Standard del Bolognese
enci-bolognese-breed-standard.note: Official Italian kennel club (ENCI / Ente Nazionale della Cinofilia Italiana) standard and breed profile for the Bolognese, detailing historical Italian origins, Renaissance nobility, square build, flocky coat, height, weight (2.5-4 kg), and health.

akc-bolognese-breed-profile.name: American Kennel Club - Bolognese Dog Breed Information
akc-bolognese-breed-profile.note: Official AKC breed profile (Miscellaneous Class, Toy Group designation) covering Italian history, height (10-12 in), weight (6-10 lb), lifespan (12-14 years), temperament, grooming, separation anxiety, and recommended health tests (Patella Evaluation, PRA/PRCD, CAER Eye Examination).

the-kennel-club-bolognese-breed-standard.name: The Royal Kennel Club - Bolognese Breed Standard
the-kennel-club-bolognese-breed-standard.note: Official Royal Kennel Club breed standard (Toy Group) confirming square proportions, pure white flocky coat, high-set ears carried away from the head, and UK arrival in 1989.

ukc-bolognese-breed-standard.name: United Kennel Club - Bolognese Breed Standard
ukc-bolognese-breed-standard.note: Official UKC breed standard (Companion Dog Group, recognized 1995, revised 2012) covering conformation, square proportions, flocky white coat, height, weight, and companion behavior.

ofa-bolognese-health-screenings.name: Orthopedic Foundation for Animals - Bolognese Health Screening Guidelines
ofa-bolognese-health-screenings.note: Orthopedic Foundation for Animals CHIC / breed health screening portal for the Bolognese covering patellar luxation, eye examinations (CAER), PRA-prcd, and cardiac evaluations.

srhk-belgian-shepherd-breed-standard.name: Société Royale Saint-Hubert - Standard du Chien de Berger Belge
srhk-belgian-shepherd-breed-standard.note: Official Belgian kennel club (SRSH / Société Royale Saint-Hubert) standard and breed profile for the Belgian Shepherd, detailing Château de Groenendael foundation history, Professor Reul 1891 breed separation, height limits, weight parameters, and working sheepdog trials.

akc-belgian-sheepdog-breed-standard.name: American Kennel Club - Official Standard of the Belgian Sheepdog
akc-belgian-sheepdog-breed-standard.note: Official AKC breed standard (effective June 11, 1990, Herding Group) establishing height (males 24 to 26 inches / 61-66 cm, females 22 to 24 inches / 56-61 cm), square proportions, solid black long double coat, scissor bite, and herding temperament.

akc-belgian-sheepdog-breed-profile.name: American Kennel Club - Belgian Sheepdog Dog Breed Information
akc-belgian-sheepdog-breed-profile.note: Official AKC breed profile covering Belgian history (Château de Groenendael, Nicolas Rose), World War I sentry work, published weight (45-75 lbs / approx. 20-34 kg), lifespan (12-14 years), temperament, and grooming.

the-kennel-club-belgian-shepherd-dog-gro.name: The Royal Kennel Club - Belgian Shepherd Dog (Groenendael) Breed Standard
the-kennel-club-belgian-shepherd-dog-gro.note: Official Royal Kennel Club breed standard (Pastoral Group) confirming withers height (dogs 61-66 cm; bitches 56-61 cm), square proportions, solid black long coat (muzzle frosting normal; small white on forechest and toes tolerated), and working sheepdog temperament.

ukc-belgian-shepherd-dog-breed-standard.name: United Kennel Club - Belgian Shepherd Dog Breed Standard
ukc-belgian-shepherd-dog-breed-standard.note: Official UKC breed standard (Herding Dog Group, recognized 1991) covering conformation, square proportions, four coat varieties including Groenendael, height, weight, and herding behavior.

ofa-belgian-sheepdog-chic-requirements.name: Orthopedic Foundation for Animals - Belgian Sheepdog CHIC Requirements
ofa-belgian-sheepdog-chic-requirements.note: Official OFA Canine Health Information Center (CHIC) testing requirements for the Belgian Sheepdog / Groenendael, mandating radiographic hip dysplasia evaluation, radiographic elbow dysplasia evaluation, and CAER eye examination.

belgian-shepherd-idiopathic-epilepsy-stu.name: Genome-Wide Association Analysis of Idiopathic Epilepsy in the Belgian Shepherd (Canine Genet Epidemiol 2020)
belgian-shepherd-idiopathic-epilepsy-stu.note: Peer-reviewed scientific study (Belanger et al., Canine Genet Epidemiol 2020;7:12, PMID 32944234) identifying significant genetic risk loci on chromosomes 14 and 37 associated with idiopathic epilepsy in Belgian Shepherd dogs.
belgian-shepherd-idiopathic-epilepsy-stu.publisher: Canine Genetics and Epidemiology / PubMed Central

fci-basset-bleu-de-gascogne-official-sta.name: FCI - Basset Bleu de Gascogne Official Breed Standard No. 35
fci-basset-bleu-de-gascogne-official-sta.note: Official English FCI Standard No. 35 (published 2023-09-01). Covers French origin, Group 6 Scenthounds and related breeds, Section 1.3 Small-sized Hounds with working trial, mottled slate-blue coat with black patches and tan points (other coats disqualifying), and withers height (34-38 cm for males and females).

fci-basset-bleu-de-gascogne-nomenclature.name: FCI - Basset Bleu de Gascogne Breed Nomenclature (No. 35)
fci-basset-bleu-de-gascogne-nomenclature.note: Official FCI breed nomenclature record confirming France as country of origin, Group 6 Section 1.3 Small-sized Hounds with working trial, definitive recognition date (1963-10-30), English standard published 2023-09-01, and multilingual names.

scc-basset-bleu-de-gascogne-breed-standa.name: Société Centrale Canine - Standard et Profil du Basset Bleu de Gascogne
scc-basset-bleu-de-gascogne-breed-standa.note: Official French kennel club (SCC) breed profile and standard for the Basset Bleu de Gascogne, confirming historical Gascon origin, height (34-38 cm), weight range (approx. 16-20 kg), hunting trials, and pack hound traits.

club-du-bleu-de-gascogne-profile.name: Club du Bleu de Gascogne, Gascon Saintongeois et Ariégeois - Basset Bleu de Gascogne
club-du-bleu-de-gascogne-profile.note: Official French parent breed club working standard article on Société Centrale Canine covering nose, deep howling voice (hurleur), steady pace, gun-hunting style, and pack behavior.
club-du-bleu-de-gascogne-profile.publisher: Club du Bleu de Gascogne, Gascon Saintongeois et Ariégeois (Société Centrale Canine)

ukc-basset-bleu-de-gascogne-breed-standa.name: United Kennel Club - Basset Bleu de Gascogne Breed Standard
ukc-basset-bleu-de-gascogne-breed-standa.note: Official UKC breed standard (Scenthound Group, recognized 1991) covering conformation, rectangular low-slung proportions, mottled blue coat, height (13.5 to 15 inches / 34-38 cm), and hunting behavior.

akc-basset-bleu-de-gascogne-breed-profil.name: American Kennel Club - Basset Bleu de Gascogne Dog Breed Information
akc-basset-bleu-de-gascogne-breed-profil.note: Official AKC breed profile (Foundation Stock Service, Hound Group) covering southwestern French history, slate-blue mottling, published weight (35-44 lbs / approx. 16-20 kg), lifespan (12-14 years), temperament, and care.

fci-croatian-shepherd-dog-official-stand.name: FCI - Croatian Shepherd Dog (Hrvatski ovčar) Official Breed Standard No. 277
fci-croatian-shepherd-dog-official-stand.note: Official English FCI Standard No. 277 (valid standard dated 2014-11-03, English edition published 2015-05-27). Covers Croatian origin in Slavonia, Group 1 Section 1 Sheepdogs without working trial, wavy/curly black coat with short-haired head, withers height (40-50 cm), and weight (13-20 kg).

fci-croatian-shepherd-dog-nomenclature.name: FCI - Croatian Shepherd Dog Breed Nomenclature (No. 277)
fci-croatian-shepherd-dog-nomenclature.note: Official FCI breed nomenclature record confirming Croatia as country of origin, Group 1 Section 1 Sheepdogs not subject to a working trial, definitive FCI acceptance date (1967-08-30), valid standard dated 2014-11-03, and multilingual names.

hks-hrvatski-ovcar-breed-standard.name: Hrvatski kinološki savez (MOJ PAS) - Hrvatski ovčar
hks-hrvatski-ovcar-breed-standard.note: Official Croatian Kennel Club (HKS) Moj Pas portal article on the history and autochthonous status of the Croatian Sheepdog.

akc-croatian-sheepdog-breed-profile.name: American Kennel Club - Croatian Sheepdog Dog Breed Information
akc-croatian-sheepdog-breed-profile.note: Official AKC breed profile (Foundation Stock Service, Herding Group) covering Slavonian history, Bishop Peter 1374 chronicle, agility speed, weight (29-44 lbs / approx. 13-20 kg), lifespan (12-14 years), temperament, and grooming.

ukc-croatian-shepherd-dog-breed-standard.name: United Kennel Club - Croatian Shepherd Dog Breed Standard
ukc-croatian-shepherd-dog-breed-standard.note: Official UKC breed standard (Herding Dog Group, recognized 2006) covering conformation, rectangular proportions, wavy black coat, height (16 to 20 inches / 40-50 cm), weight (approx. 29 to 44 lbs), and herding behavior.

akc-kerry-blue-terrier-breed-standard.name: American Kennel Club — Official Standard of the Kerry Blue Terrier

ofa-bouvier-des-flandres-chic-requiremen.note: Official OFA Canine Health Information Center (CHIC) breed health screening listing for the Bouvier des Flandres (hip dysplasia, elbow dysplasia, cardiac, and ophthalmic evaluations).

fci-basset-fauve-de-bretagne-official-st.name: FCI - Basset Fauve de Bretagne (Fawn Brittany Basset) Official Breed Standard No. 36
fci-basset-fauve-de-bretagne-official-st.note: Official English FCI Standard No. 36 (valid standard dated 2003-03-25; English PDF published 2003-05-05). Covers French origin in Brittany, Group 6 Scenthounds and related breeds, Section 1.3 Small-sized Hounds classification with working trial, compact agile basset build, very rough harsh fawn wiry coat (golden wheaten to brick red), and withers height (32 to 38 cm for both males and females, +/- 2 cm tolerance).

fci-basset-fauve-de-bretagne-nomenclatur.name: FCI - Basset Fauve de Bretagne Breed Nomenclature (No. 36)
fci-basset-fauve-de-bretagne-nomenclatur.note: Official FCI breed nomenclature record confirming France as country of origin, Group 6 Section 1.3 Small-sized Hounds classification with working trial, definitive recognition date (1963-10-30), and official names (Basset Fauve de Bretagne, Basset Leonado de Bretaña).

scc-basset-fauve-de-bretagne-standard.name: Société Centrale Canine - Standard et Profil du Basset Fauve de Bretagne
scc-basset-fauve-de-bretagne-standard.note: Official French kennel club (SCC) breed profile for Basset Fauve de Bretagne, documenting Brittany heritage, Grand Fauve de Bretagne lineage, 1949 founding of the Club du Fauve de Bretagne, sociable balanced temperament, apartment adaptability with three daily outings, and hunting trials.

club-du-fauve-de-bretagne-profile.name: Club du Fauve de Bretagne - Official Breed Club Portal (Centrale Canine)
club-du-fauve-de-bretagne-profile.note: Official French parent breed club portal affiliated with Société Centrale Canine covering the Basset Fauve de Bretagne and Griffon Fauve de Bretagne.

the-kennel-club-basset-fauve-de-bretagne.name: The Royal Kennel Club - Basset Fauve de Bretagne Breed Standard
the-kennel-club-basset-fauve-de-bretagne.note: Official Royal Kennel Club breed standard (Hound Group, updated April 1, 2025) confirming short-legged rough-coated hound conformation, medium-length balanced head, inward-folding pointed ears, and courageous, hardy, nimble characteristics.

akc-basset-fauve-de-bretagne-breed-profi.name: American Kennel Club - Basset Fauve de Bretagne Dog Breed Information
akc-basset-fauve-de-bretagne-breed-profi.note: Official AKC breed profile (Hound Group; entered FSS in Feb 2015, fully recognized effective Dec 31, 2025 / 2026) covering height (12.5-15.5 inches), weight (23-39 pounds), lifespan (13-16 years), grooming, National Breed Club recommended health tests (patella, cardiac, ophthalmologist), POAG DNA testing, and documented health conditions.

ukc-basset-fauve-de-bretagne-breed-stand.name: United Kennel Club - Basset Fauve de Bretagne Breed Standard
ukc-basset-fauve-de-bretagne-breed-stand.note: Preserved existing UKC source entry (Scenthound Group); direct ukcdogs.com page could not be fetched live during 2026-11-25 verification, so primary conformation and sizing rely on FCI, Royal Kennel Club, SCC, and AKC.

fci-australian-cattle-dog-official-stand.name: FCI - Australian Cattle Dog Official Breed Standard No. 287
fci-australian-cattle-dog-official-stand.note: Official English FCI Standard No. 287 (valid standard dated 2012-10-08, English PDF published 2012-12-05). Covers Australian origin, Group 1 Sheepdogs and Cattledogs, Section 2 Cattledogs (except Swiss Cattledogs) without working trial, 10:9 proportions, smooth double coat (2.5-4 cm), blue-mottled and red-speckled colours, and withers height (males 46-51 cm, females 43-48 cm).

fci-australian-cattle-dog-nomenclature.name: FCI - Australian Cattle Dog Breed Nomenclature (No. 287)
fci-australian-cattle-dog-nomenclature.note: Official FCI breed nomenclature record confirming Australia as country of origin, Group 1 Section 2 Cattledogs (except Swiss Cattledogs) without working trial, definitive recognition date (1972-03-20), valid standard date (2012-10-08), and multilingual names (Australian Cattle Dog, Bouvier Australien, Australischer Treibhund, Boyero Australiano).

dogs-australia-australian-cattle-dog-sta.name: Dogs Australia (ANKC) - Australian Cattle Dog Breed Standard
dogs-australia-australian-cattle-dog-sta.note: Official Dogs Australia (ANKC) country-of-origin breed standard (Group 5 Working Dogs, last updated 2009-12-14) covering general appearance, characteristics, temperament, coat, colour, and height limits (dogs 46-51 cms, bitches 43-48 cms).

akc-australian-cattle-dog-breed-standard.name: American Kennel Club - Official Standard of the Australian Cattle Dog
akc-australian-cattle-dog-breed-standard.note: Official AKC breed standard (Herding Group; approved January 11, 1999, effective February 24, 1999) specifying height in centimetres first (dogs 46-51 cm / approx. 18-20 in; bitches 43-48 cm / approx. 17-19 in), 10:9 proportions, smooth rain-resisting double coat (2.5-4 cm), blue and red speckle colours, scissor bite, and alert protective working temperament.

akc-australian-cattle-dog-breed-profile.name: American Kennel Club - Australian Cattle Dog Breed Information
akc-australian-cattle-dog-breed-profile.note: Official AKC breed profile (Herding Group, recognized 1980) covering height (18-20 in male, 17-19 in female), weight (35-50 pounds), lifespan (12-16 years), grooming, exercise, training, and National Breed Club recommended health tests (hip, elbow, ophthalmologist, BAER, PLL DNA, prcd-PRA DNA).

ofa-australian-cattle-dog-chic-requireme.name: Orthopedic Foundation for Animals - Australian Cattle Dog CHIC Requirements
ofa-australian-cattle-dog-chic-requireme.note: Official OFA Canine Health Information Center (CHIC) health testing program listing for the Australian Cattle Dog (hip, elbow, ophthalmologist, BAER hearing, Primary Lens Luxation DNA, and prcd-PRA DNA evaluations).

australian-cattle-dog-prcd-pra-study-200.name: Identical mutation in a novel retinal gene causes progressive rod-cone degeneration in dogs and retinitis pigmentosa in humans (Genomics 2006)
australian-cattle-dog-prcd-pra-study-200.note: Peer-reviewed study (Zangerl et al., Genomics 2006 Nov;88(5):551-63, Epub 2006-08-30, PMID 16938425, DOI 10.1016/j.ygeno.2006.07.007) identifying the causal autosomal recessive PRCD gene mutation (TGC -> TAC) responsible for progressive rod-cone degeneration (prcd-PRA) across 18 dog breeds/varieties including the Australian Cattle Dog.

wikimedia-australian-cattle-dog-wonderch.note: Verified high-resolution photograph (4032 x 3024 px) of an adult blue-mottled Australian Cattle Dog in side profile outdoors by Wonderchook (captured 2022-06-21, uploaded 2023-04-07). Licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 International on Wikimedia Commons.

wikimedia-australian-cattle-dog-jasperfr.note: Verified photograph (341 x 480 px) of an Australian Cattle Dog cooling off in mud outdoors by Jasperfriendlydog (EXIF captured 2005-07-22, originally uploaded to English Wikipedia 2006-03-29, transferred to Wikimedia Commons 2008-02-09 by Million Moments). fci-grand-anglo-francais-blanc-et-noir-o.name: FCI - Grand Anglo-Français Blanc et Noir (Great Anglo-French White and Black Hound) Official Breed Standard No. 323
fci-grand-anglo-francais-blanc-et-noir-o.note: Official English FCI Standard No. 323 (valid standard dated 2008-11-04; English PDF published 2009-01-12). Covers French origin, Group 6 Scenthounds and related breeds, Section 1.1 Large-sized Hounds classification with working trial, white-and-black mantle with pale tan points and roebuck mark, and withers height (males 65-72 cm, females 62-68 cm).

fci-grand-anglo-francais-blanc-et-noir-n.name: FCI - Grand Anglo-Français Blanc et Noir Breed Nomenclature (No. 323)
fci-grand-anglo-francais-blanc-et-noir-n.note: Official FCI breed nomenclature record confirming France as country of origin, Group 6 Section 1.1 Large-sized Hounds classification with working trial, definitive recognition date (1983-01-27), official valid standard date (2008-11-04), and multilingual names (Great Anglo-French White and Black Hound, Grand Anglo-Français Blanc et Noir, Großer Anglo-Französischer Weiß-Schwarzer Laufhund, Gran Sabueso Anglo-Francés Blanco y Negro).

scc-grand-anglo-francais-blanc-et-noir-s.name: Société Centrale Canine - Standard et Profil du Grand Anglo-Français Blanc et Noir
scc-grand-anglo-francais-blanc-et-noir-s.note: Official French kennel club (Société Centrale Canine / SCC) breed profile for Grand Anglo-Français Blanc et Noir, confirming Bâtard Anglo-Saintongeois origins, ~2,000 French population (~200 births/year across ~20 roe-deer packs and 1 red-deer pack), height (males 65-72 cm, females 62-68 cm), indicative weight ('Environ 25 kg'), white-and-black coat with roebuck mark, friendly kennel temperament, and unsuitability for city living.

wikimedia-grand-anglo-francais-noir-alep.note: Verified photograph (800 x 600 px) of an adult Grand Anglo-Français Blanc et Noir at full gallop during a drag hunt by Alephalpha (captured 2006-10-22, uploaded 2008-10-21). Dual-licensed under CC BY-SA 3.0 Unported and GFDL 1.2+ on Wikimedia Commons.

fci-picardy-spaniel-official-standard.name: FCI - Picardy Spaniel (Epagneul Picard) Official Breed Standard No. 108
fci-picardy-spaniel-official-standard.note: Official English FCI Standard No. 108 (official valid standard dated 2023-06-08; English PDF published 2023-08-24). Covers French origin in Picardy, Group 7 Pointing Dogs, Section 1.2 Continental Pointing Dogs (Spaniel type) with working trial, body length ~1/10th longer than height, dense slightly wavy 'autumn leaves' coat, and updated withers height (males 57-62 cm, females 55-60 cm, +/- 2 cm tolerance).

fci-picardy-spaniel-nomenclature.name: FCI - Picardy Spaniel Breed Nomenclature (No. 108)
fci-picardy-spaniel-nomenclature.note: Official FCI breed nomenclature record confirming France as country of origin, Group 7 Section 1.2 Continental Pointing Dogs (Spaniel type) with working trial, definitive recognition date (1954-12-08), valid standard date (2023-06-08), and official names (Picardy Spaniel, Epagneul Picard, Picardie-Spaniel, Spaniel Picardo).

scc-epagneul-picard-standard.name: Société Centrale Canine - Standard et Profil de l'Epagneul Picard
scc-epagneul-picard-standard.note: Official French kennel club (Société Centrale Canine / SCC) breed profile for Epagneul Picard, documenting Picardy wet-valley heritage, grey-and-brown coat with tan markings, docile child-friendly temperament, city adaptability with long daily walks, and 'Poids: NP' (weight not specified).

club-epagneul-picard-profile.name: Club des Épagneuls de Picardie et Pont-Audemer (CEPPA) - Epagneul Picard
club-epagneul-picard-profile.note: Official French parent breed club (CEPPA, founded 1921 in Amiens, affiliated with SCC) breed profile covering close-range quartering, soft-mouthed land and water retrieving, docile family temperament, and litter hip dysplasia tracking.
club-epagneul-picard-profile.publisher: Club des Épagneuls de Picardie et Pont-Audemer (CEPPA)

ukc-picardy-spaniel-breed-standard.name: United Kennel Club - Picardy Spaniel Breed Standard
ukc-picardy-spaniel-breed-standard.note: Preserved existing UKC source entry (Gun Dog Group); direct ukcdogs.com page could not be fetched live during 2026-11-26 verification, so primary conformation and sizing rely on the 2023 FCI Standard No. 108, SCC, and CEPPA.

fci-dogo-argentino-official-standard.name: FCI - Dogo Argentino Official Breed Standard No. 292
fci-dogo-argentino-official-standard.note: Official English FCI Standard No. 292 (valid standard dated 2011-11-10; English PDF published 2012-08-02). Covers Argentine origin in Córdoba, Group 2 Section 2.1 Mastiff-type Molossoids without working trial, completely white short smooth coat (dark head patch <=10%), convex skull, withers height (males 60-68 cm, females 60-65 cm), and weight (males 40-45 kg, females 40-43 kg).

fci-dogo-argentino-nomenclature.name: FCI - Dogo Argentino Breed Nomenclature (No. 292)
fci-dogo-argentino-nomenclature.note: Official FCI breed nomenclature record confirming Argentina as country of origin, Group 2 Section 2.1 Mastiff-type Molossoids without working trial, definitive recognition date (1973-07-31), valid standard date (2011-11-10), and official multilingual names (Dogo Argentino, Dogue Argentin, Argentinische Dogge).

akc-dogo-argentino-breed-standard.name: American Kennel Club - Official Standard of the Dogo Argentino
akc-dogo-argentino-breed-standard.note: Official AKC breed standard (Working Group, recognized 2020) establishing proportions, heavy bone structure, completely white short smooth coat with <=10% dark head patch tolerance, and big-game hunting temperament.

akc-dogo-argentino-breed-profile.name: American Kennel Club - Dogo Argentino Dog Breed Information
akc-dogo-argentino-breed-profile.note: Official AKC breed profile (Working Group, recognized 2020) covering Dr. Antonio Nores Martinez's 1928 Córdoba origins, height (24-26.5 in male, 24-25.5 in female), weight (80-100 pounds), life expectancy (9-15 years), grooming, exercise, and National Breed Club recommended health tests (Hip Evaluation, Cardiac Exam, BAER Testing).

ukc-dogo-argentino-breed-standard.name: United Kennel Club - Dogo Argentino Breed Standard
ukc-dogo-argentino-breed-standard.note: Preserved existing UKC source entry (Guardian Dog Group); primary measurements and health data rely on FCI Standard No. 292, AKC, DACA, OFA, and PubMed.

daca-health-programs.name: Dogo Argentino Club of America - Health Programs
daca-health-programs.note: Official AKC parent club (Dogo Argentino Club of America, founded 1985) health portal covering CHIC health program screening (BAER hearing, hip, and cardiac evaluations) and breed health education.

ofa-dogo-argentino-chic-requirements.name: Orthopedic Foundation for Animals - Dogo Argentino CHIC Requirements
ofa-dogo-argentino-chic-requirements.note: Official OFA Canine Health Information Center (CHIC) testing requirements for the Dogo Argentino (BAER hearing, hip dysplasia, and cardiac evaluations).

fci-greater-swiss-mountain-dog-official-.name: FCI - Greater Swiss Mountain Dog (Grosser Schweizer Sennenhund) Official Breed Standard No. 58
fci-greater-swiss-mountain-dog-official-.note: Official English FCI Standard No. 58 (valid standard dated 2003-03-25; English PDF published 2003-05-05). Covers Swiss origin, Group 2 Section 3 Swiss Mountain- and Cattledogs without working trial, 1:1 skull-to-muzzle length, clean non-pendulous lips, tricolor double coat, and withers height (males 65-72 cm, females 60-68 cm).

fci-greater-swiss-mountain-dog-nomenclat.name: FCI - Great Swiss Mountain Dog Breed Nomenclature (No. 58)
fci-greater-swiss-mountain-dog-nomenclat.note: Official FCI breed nomenclature record confirming Switzerland as country of origin, Group 2 Section 3 Swiss Mountain- and Cattledogs without working trial, definitive recognition date (1954-08-13), valid standard date (2003-03-25), and multilingual names (Great Swiss Mountain Dog, Grand Bouvier Suisse, Grosser Schweizer Sennenhund, Gran Boyero Suizo).

akc-greater-swiss-mountain-dog-breed-sta.name: American Kennel Club - Official Standard of the Greater Swiss Mountain Dog
akc-greater-swiss-mountain-dog-breed-sta.note: Official AKC breed standard (Working Group; approved April 8, 2003, effective May 29, 2003) establishing 10:9 proportions, heavy bone, dry-mouthed lips, tricolor double coat (1.25-2 in topcoat with undercoat), and height limits (dogs 25.5-28.5 inches, bitches 23.5-27 inches).

akc-greater-swiss-mountain-dog-breed-pro.name: American Kennel Club - Greater Swiss Mountain Dog Breed Information
akc-greater-swiss-mountain-dog-breed-pro.note: Official AKC breed profile (Working Group, recognized 1995) covering weight (115-140 lb males, 85-110 lb females), lifespan (8-11 years), moderate exercise, training (avoid walking harnesses), nutrition (avoid overfeeding/obesity), health (splenic torsion, bloat, urinary incontinence, epilepsy), and National Breed Club recommended tests (hip, elbow, ophthalmologist, shoulder).

ukc-greater-swiss-mountain-dog-breed-sta.name: United Kennel Club - Greater Swiss Mountain Dog Breed Standard
ukc-greater-swiss-mountain-dog-breed-sta.note: Preserved existing UKC source entry (Guardian Dog Group); primary measurements and health data rely on FCI Standard No. 58, AKC, GSMDCA Health Foundation, and OFA.

gsmdca-greater-swiss-mountain-dog-health.name: Greater Swiss Mountain Dog Club of America - Health Foundation
gsmdca-greater-swiss-mountain-dog-health.note: Official GSMDCA Health Foundation orthopedic page covering hip dysplasia, elbow dysplasia, shoulder osteochondrosis dissecans (OCD), and CHIC basic health screening recommendations.
gsmdca-greater-swiss-mountain-dog-health.publisher: Greater Swiss Mountain Dog Club of America

ofa-greater-swiss-mountain-dog-chic-requ.name: Orthopedic Foundation for Animals - Greater Swiss Mountain Dog CHIC Requirements
ofa-greater-swiss-mountain-dog-chic-requ.note: Official OFA Canine Health Information Center (CHIC) testing requirements for the Greater Swiss Mountain Dog (hip dysplasia, elbow dysplasia, shoulder OCD, and ophthalmologist eye evaluations).

wikimedia-greater-swiss-mountain-dog-swi.note: Verified photograph (1466 x 985 px) of a 3-year-old female Greater Swiss Mountain Dog ('Schubert') outdoors by Swissy (captured 2007-05-11, uploaded 2007-05-16). Dual-licensed under CC BY-SA 3.0 Unported and GFDL 1.2+ on Wikimedia Commons.

fci-greyhound-official-standard.name: FCI - Greyhound Official Breed Standard No. 158
fci-greyhound-official-standard.note: Official English FCI Standard No. 158 (valid standard dated 2026-09-08, published 2026-10-06). Covers Great Britain origin, Group 10 Sighthounds, Section 3 Short-haired Sighthounds classification without working trial, fine close coat, accepted colours (black, white, red, blue, fallow, brindle, or broken with white), and ideal withers height (dogs 71-76 cm, bitches 68-71 cm).

fci-greyhound-nomenclature.name: FCI - Greyhound Breed Nomenclature (No. 158)
fci-greyhound-nomenclature.note: Official FCI breed nomenclature page confirming Great Britain origin, Group 10 Section 3 classification without working trial, and French name LEVRIER ANGLAIS.

the-kennel-club-greyhound-breed-standard.name: The Royal Kennel Club - Greyhound Breed Standard
the-kennel-club-greyhound-breed-standard.note: Official Royal Kennel Club breed standard (Hound Group, last updated 2025-08-01) establishing ideal height (dogs 71-76 cms, bitches 69-71 cms), fine close coat, deep chest, powerful hindquarters, complete scissor bite, and gentle temperament.

akc-greyhound-breed-standard.name: American Kennel Club - Official Standard of the Greyhound
akc-greyhound-breed-standard.note: Official AKC breed standard (Hound Group) specifying weight (dogs 65 to 70 pounds, bitches 60 to 65 pounds), color immaterial, short smooth firm coat, and hard close hare-like feet.

akc-greyhound-breed-profile.name: American Kennel Club - Greyhound Dog Breed Information
akc-greyhound-breed-profile.note: Official AKC breed profile covering Fourth Dynasty Egyptian Tomb of Amten history (2900-2751 BCE), hare coursing, height (28-30 in / 27-28 in), weight (65-70 lb / 60-65 lb), lifespan (10-13 years), higher calorie/protein nutrition note, grooming, gentle training, and national breed club recommended health tests (Cardiac Exam, Ophthalmologist Evaluation, Greyhound Polyneuropathy DNA Test).

ofa-greyhound-chic-requirements.name: Orthopedic Foundation for Animals - Greyhound CHIC Requirements
ofa-greyhound-chic-requirements.note: OFA Canine Health Information Center (CHIC) testing panel for the Greyhound: Greyhound Polyneuropathy (NDRG1) DNA test, Ophthalmologist Evaluation (CAER), and Cardiac Evaluation.

greyhound-neuropathy-ndrg1-study-2010.name: A Deletion in the N-myc Downstream Regulated Gene 1 (NDRG1) Gene in Greyhounds with Polyneuropathy (PLoS One)
greyhound-neuropathy-ndrg1-study-2010.note: Peer-reviewed study (Drögemüller et al., PLoS One 2010;5(6):e11258, PMID 20582309, PMCID PMC2889825, DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0011258) identifying an autosomal recessive 10-bp deletion in canine NDRG1 exon 15 (c.1080_1089delTCGCCTGGAC) causing polyneuropathy in Greyhound show dogs. Corrected broken PMID 20585648 to verified PMID 20582309.

fci-cane-corso-italiano-official-standar.name: FCI - Cane Corso Italiano Official Breed Standard No. 343
fci-cane-corso-italiano-official-standar.note: Official English FCI Standard No. 343 (published 2023-10-13). Covers Italian origin, Group 2 Section 2.1 Mastiff type Molossoids (subject to a working trial), slightly converging skull/muzzle axes, short shiny very dense coat with slight undercoat of vitreous texture, accepted colours (black, lead-grey/blue, slate-grey/blue, light grey/blue, light/dark fawn, stag red, dark wheat, black brindle, grey/blue brindle), ideal height (males 64-68 cm, females 60-64 cm, +/- 2 cm tolerance), and weight (males 45-50 kg, females 40-45 kg).

fci-cane-corso-italiano-nomenclature.name: FCI - Cane Corso Italiano Breed Nomenclature (No. 343)
fci-cane-corso-italiano-nomenclature.note: Official FCI breed nomenclature confirming Italy as country of origin, Group 2 Section 2.1 Mastiff type Molossoids, subject to a working trial, provisional acceptance 1996-11-12, definitive acceptance 2007-05-21, English standard published 2023-10-13, and French name CHIEN DE COUR ITALIEN.

enci-cane-corso-italiano-standard.name: Ente Nazionale della Cinofilia Italiana - Cane Corso
enci-cane-corso-italiano-standard.note: Official Italian Kennel Club (ENCI) breed page for Cane Corso (updated URL from /cane-corso-italiano to /cane-corso), covering general appearance, guardian/working heritage, and selected breeding requirements (HD, ED, CAE-1).

akc-cane-corso-breed-standard.name: American Kennel Club - Official Standard of the Cane Corso
akc-cane-corso-breed-standard.note: Official AKC breed standard (Working Group) covering height (males 25-27.5 in, females 23.5-26 in), proportionate weight, strong bone structure, slightly undershot bite, coat, and protective temperament.

akc-cane-corso-breed-profile.name: American Kennel Club - Cane Corso Dog Breed Information
akc-cane-corso-breed-profile.note: Official AKC breed profile covering Roman molossoid heritage, 'cohors' etymology, plural 'Cani Corsi', 1970s revival, lifespan (9-12 years), temperament, exercise, grooming, and bloat awareness.

ccaa-cane-corso-health.name: Cane Corso Association of America - Breed Health and CHIC Testing
ccaa-cane-corso-health.note: Official national parent club health page specifying the six required CHIC screenings: Hip Dysplasia (OFA or PennHIP), Elbow Dysplasia, Cardiac, Patellar Luxation, NCL DNA test, and DSRA DNA test; also links to OFA breed=COR.

ofa-cane-corso-chic-requirements.name: Orthopedic Foundation for Animals - Cane Corso CHIC Requirements
ofa-cane-corso-chic-requirements.note: Official OFA Canine Health Information Center (CHIC) page for Cane Corso (corrected URL from ?breed=CCO to ?breed=COR). Required tests: Hip Dysplasia, Elbow Dysplasia, Cardiac, Patellar Luxation, NCL DNA test, and DSRA DNA test.

cane-corso-dsra-mia3-study-2021.name: MIA3 Splice Defect in Cane Corso Dogs with Dental-Skeletal-Retinal Anomaly (DSRA)
cane-corso-dsra-mia3-study-2021.note: Peer-reviewed study (Christen et al., Genes (Basel) 2021 Sep 25;12(10):1497, PMID 34680893, DOI 10.3390/genes12101497) identifying an autosomal recessive MIA3 splice variant (c.3822+3_3822+4del) causing Dental-Skeletal-Retinal Anomaly (DSRA) in Cane Corso dogs. Corrected PMID from 34680892 to 34680893 and publication date to 2021-09-25.

wikimedia-cane-corso-2021-03-wojciech.note: High-resolution photograph (4691 x 3564 px) of an adult Cane Corso outdoors by Wojciech Pędzich (captured 2021-08-14, uploaded 2022-04-26). Licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0. Note: Commons page currently displays a 'lacking source information' maintenance notice despite matching photographer and uploader.

wikimedia-cane-corso-17-wili15.name: Wikimedia Commons - File:Cane corso 17.jpg
wikimedia-cane-corso-17-wili15.note: Verified photograph (3872 x 2592 px) of a large adult Cane Corso outdoors by Wili15 (Own work; captured 2014-04-17, cross-wiki uploaded to Commons 2017-12-17). Licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0.

fci-lagotto-romagnolo-official-standard.name: FCI - Lagotto Romagnolo (Romagna Water Dog) Official Breed Standard No. 298
fci-lagotto-romagnolo-official-standard.note: Official English FCI Standard No. 298 (published 2026-10-02). Covers Italian origin, Group 8 Section 3 Water Dogs, dense woolly curly coat, accepted colours (black coat/patches/pigmentation disqualified), truffle-searching temperament, withers height (males 43-48 cm, ideal 46 cm; females 41-46 cm, ideal 43 cm; +/- 1 cm tolerance), and weight (males 13-16 kg, females 11-14 kg).

fci-lagotto-romagnolo-nomenclature.name: FCI - Lagotto Romagnolo Breed Nomenclature (No. 298)
fci-lagotto-romagnolo-nomenclature.note: Official FCI breed nomenclature confirming Italy as country of origin, Group 8 Section 3 Water Dogs, working trial only for countries that requested it, definitive recognition, English standard published 2026-10-02, and French official name CHIEN D'EAU ROMAGNOL.

dogs-australia-lagotto-romagnolo-standar.name: Dogs Australia (ANKC) - Lagotto Romagnolo Breed Standard
dogs-australia-lagotto-romagnolo-standar.note: Official Dogs Australia (ANKC) breed standard (Group 3 Gundogs) detailing Comacchio and Ravenna marshlands history, height (43-48 cm / 41-46 cm), weight (13-16 kg / 11-14 kg), and modified hunting instinct.

akc-lagotto-romagnolo-breed-standard.name: American Kennel Club - Official Standard for the Lagotto Romagnolo
akc-lagotto-romagnolo-breed-standard.note: Official AKC breed standard (Sporting Group) covering rustic medium build, dense curly woolly coat, bite, and truffle-searching temperament.

akc-lagotto-romagnolo-breed-profile.name: American Kennel Club - Lagotto Romagnolo Dog Breed Information
akc-lagotto-romagnolo-breed-profile.note: Official AKC breed profile covering Italian truffle-dog heritage, curly coat and facial furnishings, temperament, exercise, and grooming.

lrca-lagotto-romagnolo-health.name: Lagotto Romagnolo Club of America - Health Information
lrca-lagotto-romagnolo-health.note: Official national parent club health page (updated URL to /health-information/) confirming a 15 to 17-year life expectancy and breed health priorities including BFJE, LSD, hips, patellas, and eyes.

ofa-lagotto-romagnolo-chic-requirements.name: Lagotto Romagnolo Club of America / OFA - CHIC Requirements
ofa-lagotto-romagnolo-chic-requirements.note: Official LRCA / OFA Canine Health Information Center (CHIC) testing requirements page (updated URL to /chic/): Hip Dysplasia, Patellar Luxation, Eye/CAER examination, Benign Familial Juvenile Epilepsy (BFJE) DNA test, and Lagotto Storage Disease (LSD) DNA test.
ofa-lagotto-romagnolo-chic-requirements.publisher: Lagotto Romagnolo Club of America / Orthopedic Foundation for Animals

lagotto-romagnolo-bfje-lgi2-study.name: LGI2 Truncation Causes a Remitting Focal Epilepsy in Dogs (PLoS Genet 2011)
lagotto-romagnolo-bfje-lgi2-study.note: Peer-reviewed study (Seppälä et al., PLoS Genet 2011 Jul;7(7):e1002194, Epub 2011-07-28, PMID 21829378) identifying an autosomal recessive LGI2 truncation causing Benign Familial Juvenile Epilepsy (onset ~7 weeks, remitting by ~4 months) in Lagotto Romagnolo dogs.

wikimedia-lagotto-romagnolo-xty78.note: Verified photograph (4032 x 3024 px) of an adult Lagotto Romagnolo outdoors by XTY78 (Own work; captured and uploaded 2021-11-11). Licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0.

wikimedia-lagotto-romagnolo-sandra-schmi.note: Verified portrait (450 x 425 px) of a 9-month-old male Lagotto Romagnolo ('Manolo dei Silvanbull') by Sandra Schmidt (EXIF captured 2005-05-30; first uploaded to de.wikipedia 2005-08-06 by Canecorsodog; transferred to Commons 2006-05-14 by Caronna). Dual-licensed under CC BY-SA 3.0 and GFDL.

fci-slovakian-rough-haired-pointer-offic.name: FCI - Slovakian Wire-haired Pointing Dog (Slovenský hrubosrstý stavač) Official Breed Standard No. 320
fci-slovakian-rough-haired-pointer-offic.note: Official English FCI Standard No. 320 (valid standard dated 1995-01-06, English publication 1996-07-24; upgraded URL to HTTPS). Covers Slovakia origin, Group 7 Section 1.1 Continental Pointing Dogs ('Braque' type) with working trial, harsh ~4 cm double coat with summer-shedding fine undercoat, brown-shaded sable ('grey') colour (other basic colours disqualifying), withers height (males 62-68 cm, females 57-64 cm), and versatile field/woods/water utility.

fci-slovakian-rough-haired-pointer-nomen.name: FCI - Slovakian Wire-haired Pointing Dog Breed Nomenclature (No. 320)
fci-slovakian-rough-haired-pointer-nomen.note: Official FCI breed nomenclature confirming Slovakia origin, Group 7 Section 1.1 Continental Pointing Dogs ('Braque' type), subject to a working trial, definitive recognition 1982-02-17, valid standard 1995-01-06, English publication 1996-07-24, and multilingual names (Slovenský hrubosrstý stavač (Ohar), Wirehaired Slovakian Pointer, Braque Slovaque à poil dur, Slowakischer Rauhbart).

akc-slovakian-wirehaired-pointer-breed-p.name: American Kennel Club - Slovakian Wirehaired Pointer Dog Breed Information
akc-slovakian-wirehaired-pointer-breed-p.note: Official AKC breed profile (Foundation Stock Service) covering post-WWII Czechoslovakian origins, weight (50-65 lb), lifespan (12-15 years), temperament, and recommended health screenings (elbow and hip dysplasia, progressive retinal atrophy, cataracts).

wikimedia-slovakian-wire-haired-pointing.name: Wikimedia Commons - File:Wyzel slowacki szorstkowlosy rybnik-kamien pl.jpg

Urban Michal (EXIF captured 2005-10-09, uploaded 2006-06-01 by Prskavka~commonswiki). Released into the Public Domain (PD-self) on Wikimedia Commons.

fci-thai-bangkaew-dog-official-standard.name: FCI - Thai Bangkaew Dog Official Breed Standard No. 358
fci-thai-bangkaew-dog-official-standard.note: Official English FCI Standard No. 358 (valid standard dated 2011-04-14, English publication 2022-07-04). Covers Thailand origin (Bangkaew village, Phitsanulok province), Group 5 Section 5 Asian Spitzes without working trial, 1:1 square proportions, double coat with neck ruff and plumed tail, white-with-patches colours (all-white is a severe fault), and ideal height (males 46-55 cm, females 41-50 cm).

fci-thai-bangkaew-dog-nomenclature.name: FCI - Thai Bangkaew Dog Breed Nomenclature (No. 358)
fci-thai-bangkaew-dog-nomenclature.note: Official FCI breed nomenclature confirming Thailand origin, Group 5 Section 5 without working trial, provisional acceptance 2011-04-14, definitive acceptance 2022-06-21, English publication 2022-07-04, and French name BANGKAEW DE THAILANDE.

kath-thai-bangkaew-dog-breed-standard.name: Kennel Association of Thailand (KATH) - Thai Bangkaew Dog Breed Standard
kath-thai-bangkaew-dog-breed-standard.note: Country-of-origin breed standard and heritage page published by the Kennel Association of Thailand.

wikimedia-thai-bangkaew-dog-1-canarian.name: Wikimedia Commons - File:Thai Bangkaew Dog 1.jpg
wikimedia-thai-bangkaew-dog-1-canarian.note: Verified photograph (600 x 545 px) of a sable-and-white male Thai Bangkaew Dog outdoors by Canarian (Own work; captured 2016-12-04, uploaded 2016-12-05). Licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0.

fci-shih-tzu-official-standard.name: FCI - Shih Tzu Official Breed Standard No. 208
fci-shih-tzu-official-standard.note: Official English FCI Standard No. 208 (valid standard dated 2026-09-08, published 2026-10-06). Covers Tibet (China) origin, Great Britain patronage, Group 9 Section 5 Tibetan breeds without working trial, long dense non-curly coat with moderate non-woolly undercoat (hair not affecting vision/movement), all colours permissible except merle (unacceptable), height not more than 27 cm, and weight 4.5-8 kg (ideal 4.5-7.5 kg).

fci-shih-tzu-nomenclature.name: FCI - Shih Tzu Breed Nomenclature (No. 208)
fci-shih-tzu-nomenclature.note: Official FCI breed nomenclature confirming Tibet (China) origin, Great Britain patronage, Group 9 Section 5 without working trial, definitive recognition 1957-12-16, valid standard 2026-09-08, and English publication 2026-10-06.

akc-shih-tzu-breed-standard.name: American Kennel Club - Official Standard of the Shih Tzu
akc-shih-tzu-breed-standard.note: Official AKC breed standard (Toy Group, effective 1989-05-09) establishing sturdy toy proportions, flowing double coat, undershot or level bite, and outgoing, trusting companion temperament.

akc-shih-tzu-breed-profile.name: American Kennel Club - Shih Tzu Dog Breed Information
akc-shih-tzu-breed-profile.note: Official AKC breed profile covering Tibetan/imperial China history, 14 foundational dogs, weight (9-16 lb), lifespan (10-18 years), heat intolerance, poor swimming ability, grooming, and breeder health screenings (hip dysplasia, patellar luxation, cataracts, PRA, retinal detachment, corneal exposure/dryness).

astc-shih-tzu-health.name: American Shih Tzu Club - Health Testing and CHIC
astc-shih-tzu-health.note: Official national parent club announcement confirming Shih Tzu participation in the OFA CHIC program (August 2021) and recommending eye and patellar luxation screening.

ofa-shih-tzu-chic-requirements.name: Orthopedic Foundation for Animals - Shih Tzu CHIC Requirements
ofa-shih-tzu-chic-requirements.note: Official OFA Canine Health Information Center (CHIC) testing requirements for the Shih Tzu: Eye examination (CAER) and Clinical Patellar Luxation evaluation.

charlie-pet-health-shih-tzu.name: Charlie Pet Health - Shih Tzu health: kidneys, eyes and breathing
charlie-pet-health-shih-tzu.note: Veterinary resource covering brachycephalic breathing (BOAS), corneal ulcers, dry eye, Juvenile Renal Dysplasia (JRD), and urinary stones in Shih Tzu.

wikimedia-shih-tzu-coupe-lion.note: Verified photograph (651 x 925 px) of an adult Shih Tzu outdoors in a short trim by Pouchkine75 (Own work; captured and uploaded 2021-03-26). Licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0.

fci-presa-canario-official-standard.name: FCI - Presa Canario Official Breed Standard No. 346
fci-presa-canario-official-standard.note: Official English FCI Standard No. 346 (valid standard dated 2023-09-23, published 2023-10-05). Covers Spain (Canary Islands) origin, Group 2 Section 2.1 Mastiff type Molossoids without working trial, 60:40 skull-foreface ratio, short coarse single coat in fawn/brindle with black mask not above eye level (white >20% and cropped tail disqualifying; pincer bite a fault), height (males 60-66 cm, females 56-62 cm), and weight (males 50-65 kg, females 40-55 kg).

fci-presa-canario-nomenclature.name: FCI - Presa Canario Breed Nomenclature (No. 346)
fci-presa-canario-nomenclature.note: Official FCI breed nomenclature confirming Spain origin, Group 2 Section 2.1 without working trial, provisional acceptance 2001-06-04, definitive acceptance 2011-07-04, name restored from Dogo Canario to Presa Canario effective 2019-01-01, valid standard 2023-09-23, and English publication 2023-10-05.

rsce-presa-canario-standard.name: Real Sociedad Canina de España - Presa Canario
rsce-presa-canario-standard.note: Spanish Kennel Club (RSCE) country-of-origin reference for Presa Canario (requested FCI name restoration from Dogo Canario to Presa Canario).

akc-presa-canario-breed-profile.name: American Kennel Club - Presa Canario Dog Breed Information
akc-presa-canario-breed-profile.note: Official AKC Foundation Stock Service breed profile (recorded since 1996; renamed to Presa Canario in FSS Jan 2024). Covers height (22-26 in), weight (84-110 lb), lifespan (9-11 years), temperament (not recommended for young children or unfamiliar dogs), grooming, and general health (no mandatory national club health test panel currently listed).

ukc-presa-canario-breed-standard.name: United Kennel Club - Perro de Presa Canario Breed Standard
ukc-presa-canario-breed-standard.note: Official UKC breed standard (Guardian Dog Group, recognized 2003) covering rectangular mastiff proportions, short brindle/fawn coat, and guardian temperament.

ofa-presa-canario-chic-requirements.name: Orthopedic Foundation for Animals - Perro de Presa Canario Health Testing
ofa-presa-canario-chic-requirements.note: OFA breed health testing portal for Perro de Presa Canario covering orthopedic (hip/elbow), cardiac, and eye evaluations (note: AKC currently lists no mandatory parent club CHIC panel for the breed).

Licensed under CC BY-SA 3.0.

akc-belgian-tervuren-breed-standard.name: American Kennel Club - Official Standard of the Belgian Tervuren
akc-belgian-tervuren-breed-standard.note: Official AKC breed standard (Herding Group, approved 1990-06-11) establishing height (males 24-26 in, females 22-24 in), square proportions, rich fawn to mahogany coat with black overlay and mask, scissor bite, and alert, courageous temperament.

akc-belgian-tervuren-breed-profile.name: American Kennel Club - Belgian Tervuren Dog Breed Information
akc-belgian-tervuren-breed-profile.note: Official AKC breed profile covering Tervuren village history, M.F. Corbeel's foundation dogs 'Tom' and 'Poes', lifespan (12-14 years), weight (45-75 lb overall), grooming, and national breed club recommended health tests (Hip Evaluation, Elbow Evaluation, Ophthalmologist Evaluation, Thyroid Evaluation).

the-kennel-club-belgian-shepherd-dog-ter.name: The Royal Kennel Club - Belgian Shepherd Dog (Tervueren) Breed Standard
the-kennel-club-belgian-shepherd-dog-ter.note: Official Royal Kennel Club breed standard (Pastoral Group; updated domain to royalkennelclub.com) covering height (dogs 61-66 cm, bitches 56-61 cm), long fawn/grey coat with black overlay and black mask, and active pastoral temperament.

ofa-belgian-tervuren-chic-requirements.name: Orthopedic Foundation for Animals - Belgian Tervuren CHIC Requirements
ofa-belgian-tervuren-chic-requirements.note: Official OFA Canine Health Information Center (CHIC) testing requirements for the Belgian Tervuren (updated to unique breed-specific URL ?breed=BT): Hip Evaluation, Elbow Evaluation, Ophthalmologist Evaluation (CAER), and Thyroid Evaluation.

abtc-belgian-tervuren-health.name: American Belgian Tervuren Club - OFA Champions for Health
abtc-belgian-tervuren-health.note: Official national parent club health recognition page confirming CHIC participation and Health Education Committee evaluation.

wikimedia-belgian-tervueren-shepherd-can.name: Wikimedia Commons - File:Belgian Tervueren Shepherd.jpg
wikimedia-belgian-tervueren-shepherd-can.note: Verified high-resolution photograph (1821 x 1868 px) of an adult Belgian Tervuren outdoors by Canarian (Own work; captured 2017-12-08, uploaded 2018-01-30). Licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0.

fci-pekingese-official-standard.name: FCI - Pekingese Official Breed Standard No. 207
fci-pekingese-official-standard.note: Official English FCI Standard No. 207 (valid standard dated 2026-09-08, published 2026-10-06). Covers Chinese origin with Great Britain patronage, Group 9 Companion and Toy Dogs, Section 8 Japan Chin and Pekingese without working trial, coat-volume and eye-health welfare provisions, exclusion of albino, liver, and merle, and ideal weight not exceeding 5 kg for males and 5.4 kg for females.

fci-pekingese-nomenclature.name: FCI - Pekingese Breed Nomenclature (No. 207)
fci-pekingese-nomenclature.note: Official FCI breed nomenclature record confirming China as country of origin, Great Britain as patron, Group 9 Section 8 classification without working trial, definitive recognition date (1966-11-03), and valid standard dated 2026-09-08 (published 2026-10-06).

akc-pekingese-breed-standard.name: American Kennel Club - Official Standard of the Pekingese
akc-pekingese-breed-standard.note: Official AKC breed standard (Toy Group) establishing weight disqualification over 14 pounds, pear-shaped compact conformation, bowed forelegs and rolling gait, straight double coat with mane, and black skin pigment on muzzle, nose, lips, and eye rims.

akc-pekingese-breed-profile.name: American Kennel Club - Pekingese Dog Breed Information
akc-pekingese-breed-profile.note: Official AKC breed profile covering ancient Chinese royal history, 1860 Old Summer Palace recovery, height (6-9 inches), weight (up to 14 pounds), lifespan (12-14 years), temperament, grooming, and noting no national breed club recommended health tests.

pca-pekingese-health.name: Pekingese Club of America - Health Resources
pca-pekingese-health.note: Official Pekingese Club of America health category archive covering breed health education, respiratory, ocular, orthopedic, and general wellness topics.

ofa-pekingese-chic-requirements.name: Orthopedic Foundation for Animals - Pekingese Breed Health Listing
ofa-pekingese-chic-requirements.note: OFA breed health directory listing for Pekingese (PE); note that AKC's Toy Group health-testing directory currently lists no mandatory parent-club tests for the breed.

wikimedia-pekingese-hugo-arg.note: Photograph (1943 x 1547 px) of an adult Pekingese standing outdoors by Hugo.arg (captured 2009-01-01, uploaded 2009-01-04). Licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 on Wikimedia Commons.
