raad-van-beheer-wetterhoun-profile.note: Official Dutch Kennel Club (Raad van Beheer) breed profile for Wetterhoun detailing conformation, four colour varieties, calm non-noisy indoor character, child tolerance, minimal oily-coat grooming (avoiding shampooing and over-brushing), active outcross project, and mandatory pre-breeding health screenings (SCID DNA test, hip dysplasia, and elbow dysplasia via Dutch parent clubs; breeding standards published 2026-07-01, enforced 2026-10-01).
raad-van-beheer-wetterhoun-profile.publisher: Raad van Beheer op Kynologisch Gebied in Nederland

nvsw-wetterhoun-profile.name: Nederlandse Vereniging voor Stabij- en Wetterhounen (NVSW) - Frisian Water Dog (Wetterhoun)
nvsw-wetterhoun-profile.note: Official Dutch parent breed club (NVSW) English-language profile dedicated to the Frisian Water Dog (Wetterhoun), documenting Frisian heritage, gentle and humorous temperament, persistence in tasks, and breed stewardship.
nvsw-wetterhoun-profile.publisher: Nederlandse Vereniging voor Stabij- en Wetterhounen

akc-wetterhoun-breed-profile.name: American Kennel Club - Wetterhoun Dog Breed Information
akc-wetterhoun-breed-profile.note: Official AKC breed profile (Foundation Stock Service) documenting Friesland, Netherlands origin, otter-hunting history, rarity, height (23 inches male, 21.5 inches female), weight (50-75 pounds), and life expectancy (13 years).

pubmed-verfuurden-2011-rag1-scid-frisian.name: Severe combined immunodeficiency in Frisian Water Dogs caused by a RAG1 mutation (Genes & Immunity)
pubmed-verfuurden-2011-rag1-scid-frisian.note: Peer-reviewed study by Verfuurden et al. (Utrecht University) in Genes & Immunity (Vol. 12, No. 4, pp. 310-313, Epub 2011-02-03, PMID 21293384) identifying the autosomal-recessive RAG1 nonsense mutation (c.2893G>T; p.Glu965*) causing T-B-NK+ Severe Combined Immunodeficiency (SCID) and puppy mortality at 8-12 weeks in Frisian Water Dogs (Wetterhouns).

wikimedia-wetterhoun0002-23dingenvoormus.name: Wikimedia Commons - File:Wetterhoun0002.jpg
wikimedia-wetterhoun0002-23dingenvoormus.note: High-resolution photograph (2800 x 1867 px) of an adult black Wetterhoun (Frisian Water Dog) by 23dingenvoormusea (EXIF capture date 2010-09-29, uploaded 2010-09-30). Licensed under CC BY 3.0 Unported on Wikimedia Commons.

wikimedia-wetterhoun-aka-frisian-waterdo.name: Wikimedia Commons - File:Wetterhoun aka Frisian Waterdog.JPG
wikimedia-wetterhoun-aka-frisian-waterdo.note: Photograph (684 x 501 px) of a brown-and-white female Wetterhoun (Frisian Water Dog) by Canarian (EXIF capture date 2013-12-14, uploaded 2014-05-11). Licensed under CC BY-SA 3.0 Unported on Wikimedia Commons.

ala-australian-labradoodle-breed-standar.name: Australian Labradoodle Association (ALA) - Labradoodle Breed Standards
ala-australian-labradoodle-breed-standar.note: Official Australian Labradoodle Association (Australia) breed standard specifying three size tiers in metric first: Miniature (35-42 cm, 7-13 kg), Medium (43-52 cm, 13-20 kg), and Standard (53-63 cm, 21-30 kg), along with compact square proportions, head/ear conformation, movement, and sociable, intuitive temperament.

wala-australian-labradoodle-standard.name: Worldwide Australian Labradoodle Association (WALA) - Australian Labradoodle Breed Standard
wala-australian-labradoodle-standard.note: Official WALA Australian Labradoodle standard detailing conformation, scissor bite, three coat textures (fleece, wool, and early-generation shedding hair), continuous coat growth, grooming needs, and allergy-friendliness caveats.

alaa-labradoodle-coat-colors-guide.name: Australian Labradoodle Association of America (ALAA) - Coat Types and Coat Colors
alaa-labradoodle-coat-colors-guide.note: Official ALAA guide documenting sixteen accepted coat colours (black-pigmented and brown-pigmented varieties), six patterns (parti, tuxedo, sable, phantom, tri-phantom, roan), and the exclusion of merle from breeding.

alaa-labradoodle-health-testing-program.name: Australian Labradoodle Association of America (ALAA) - Health Testing & Paw Reward Program
alaa-labradoodle-health-testing-program.note: Official ALAA breeding health-testing requirements mandating hip and elbow radiographs (OFA/PennHIP/BVA/AVA), DNA testing for prcd-PRA and Exercise-Induced Collapse (EIC), 18-month board-certified ophthalmologist eye exams for Silver/Gold Paw tiers, and optional patella, thyroid, vWD, and cardiac evaluations.

plos-genetics-2020-australian-labradoodl.name: Genetic analysis of the modern Australian labradoodle dog breed reveals an excess of the poodle genome (PLOS Genetics)
plos-genetics-2020-australian-labradoodl.note: Peer-reviewed study by Ali et al. (PLoS Genet 16(9): e1008956, 2020, PMC7482835) analyzing 150,106 SNPs in Australian Labradoodles and F1 Labradoodles, demonstrating excess Poodle genomic ancestry in multi-generational Australian Labradoodles driven by coat-trait selection (RSPO2 furnishings, FGF5 length, KRT71 curl).
plos-genetics-2020-australian-labradoodl.publisher: PLOS Genetics / National Library of Medicine (PMC)

plos-one-2024-doodle-dilemma-bryson.name: The doodle dilemma: How the physical health of 'Designer-crossbreed' Cockapoo, Labradoodle and Cavapoo dogs compares to their purebred progenitor breeds (PLOS ONE)
plos-one-2024-doodle-dilemma-bryson.note: Peer-reviewed Royal Veterinary College VetCompass study by Bryson et al. (PLoS ONE 19(8): e0306350, 2024) comparing 9,402 dogs (including 583 Labradoodles) and finding no statistically significant health difference across 86.6% of disorder comparisons between designer crossbreeds and purebred progenitors, with lower patellar luxation risk in Labradoodles compared with Poodles.

pubmed-2021-uk-otitis-externa-vetcompass.name: Frequency and predisposing factors for canine otitis externa in the UK - a primary veterinary care epidemiological view (Canine Medicine and Genetics)
pubmed-2021-uk-otitis-externa-vetcompass.note: Peer-reviewed UK VetCompass epidemiological study (Canine Med Genet 2021;8(1):7, PMID 34488894) of 22,333 dogs documenting significantly increased odds of otitis externa in Labradoodles (OR 2.95 compared with general crossbred dogs) and drop-eared conformations.

pubmed-oliver-gould-2012-labradoodle-oph.name: Survey of ophthalmic abnormalities in the labradoodle in the UK (Veterinary Record)
pubmed-oliver-gould-2012-labradoodle-oph.note: Peer-reviewed ophthalmic survey by Oliver and Gould (Vet Rec 2012;170(15):390, PMID 22278634) of 175 UK Labradoodles documenting 4.6% multifocal retinal dysplasia (MRD) and 3.7% cataracts, advising routine pre-breeding hereditary eye screening.

frontiers-vet-sci-2026-labradoodle-eye-s.name: Retrospective evaluation of the prevalence of known and presumed hereditary eye diseases in a population of Labradoodles referred for ophthalmic screening examinations in the Netherlands (Frontiers in Veterinary Science)
frontiers-vet-sci-2026-labradoodle-eye-s.note: Peer-reviewed study by Goossens et al. (Front. Vet. Sci. 13:1841935, 2026) evaluating ECVO-certified ophthalmic screenings of 1,182 Labradoodles in the Netherlands (2014-2024), finding 7.8% affected by at least one known or presumed hereditary eye disease: iris-to-iris persistent pupillary membrane (4.7%), distichiasis (2.5%), cataracts (0.5%), and multifocal retinal dysplasia (0.2%).

wikimedia-labradoodle-brown-male-side-po.name: Wikimedia Commons - File:Labradoodle-Brown-Male-Side.jpg
wikimedia-labradoodle-brown-male-side-po.note: High-resolution photograph (2571 x 2111 px) of an adult brown male Labradoodle standing in profile by Anton Porsche / Superanton (EXIF capture date 2022-05-15, uploaded 2022-05-16). Licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 International on Wikimedia Commons.

wikimedia-labradoodle-johlum.name: Wikimedia Commons - File:Labradoodle.jpg
wikimedia-labradoodle-johlum.note: Photograph (400 x 375 px) of a cream-coated Australian Labradoodle by Johlum (capture date 2008-12-07, uploaded 2011-02-20). Dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0 on Wikimedia Commons.

rkc-scottish-terrier-breed-profile.name: The Royal Kennel Club - Scottish Terrier Breeds A to Z
rkc-scottish-terrier-breed-profile.note: Official Royal Kennel Club breed profile covering breed characteristics (Small, up to 1 hour daily exercise, sheds yes, lifespan over 10 years, town or country), history (Aberdeen terrier, 1879 naming by Captain Gordon Murray, 1882 first club), and standard colors (Black, Black Brindle, Brindle, Wheaten).

scottish-terrier-herbicide-bladder-cance.name: Herbicide Exposure and the Risk of Transitional Cell Carcinoma of the Urinary Bladder in Scottish Terriers (JAVMA 2004)
scottish-terrier-herbicide-bladder-cance.note: Peer-reviewed case-control study (Glickman et al., J Am Vet Med Assoc 2004;224(8):1290-1297, PMID 15112777; 83 TCC cases vs 83 controls) finding significantly increased TCC risk with exposure to lawns/gardens treated with herbicides alone (OR 3.62) or herbicides plus insecticides (OR 7.19), but not insecticides alone (OR 1.62).
scottish-terrier-herbicide-bladder-cance.publisher: Journal of the American Veterinary Medical Association / PubMed

fci-komondor-official-standard.name: FCI - Komondor Official Breed Standard No. 53
fci-komondor-official-standard.note: Official English FCI Standard No. 53 (published 2000-09-13). Covers Hungarian origin, Group 1 Section 1 Sheepdogs classification without working trial, giant rectangular livestock-guardian build, ivory-white corded double coat, minimum height at withers (dogs minimum 70 cm, bitches minimum 65 cm, no upper limit), and weight (dogs 50-60 kg, bitches 40-50 kg).

fci-komondor-nomenclature.name: FCI - Komondor Breed Nomenclature (No. 53)
fci-komondor-nomenclature.note: Official FCI breed nomenclature record confirming Hungary as country of origin, Group 1 Section 1 Sheepdogs classification without working trial, and English standard publication date (2000-09-13).

akc-komondor-breed-standard.name: American Kennel Club - Official Standard of the Komondor
akc-komondor-breed-standard.note: Official AKC breed standard (Working Group) covering head-to-height proportions (2/5), tight black lips, dark eyes, elongated triangular drop ears, low-set tail never carried above the back, corded white coat by age two, grey skin preference, minimum heights (27.5 in males, 25.5 in females), and disqualifications.

akc-komondor-breed-profile.name: American Kennel Club - Komondor Dog Breed Information
akc-komondor-breed-profile.note: Official AKC breed profile covering Hungarian flock-guardian history, plural 'Komondorok', life expectancy (10-12 years), corded coat separation at 9-10 months, dilute shampoo bathing, early obedience training, OFA hip dysplasia and parent-club eye health testing, and bloat awareness.

kca-about-the-komondor.name: Komondor Club of America - About The Komondor
kca-about-the-komondor.note: Official US parent breed club guide detailing livestock-guardian temperament, late maturation (~3 years), early obedience training (4-8 months), weekly cord separation, external parasite vigilance beneath heavy cords, and livestock-guardian anesthetic sensitivity (administer to effect rather than strictly by weight).

kca-komondor-faq.name: Komondor Club of America - Frequently Asked Questions
kca-komondor-faq.note: Official parent breed club FAQ covering hip dysplasia radiographic screening of breeding parents, bloat awareness, daily walking and fenced-yard exercise routines, stranger introduction protocols, and noise considerations.

pubmed-fyfe-2018-komondor-cubn-cobalamin.name: Inherited selective cobalamin malabsorption in Komondor dogs associated with a CUBN splice site variant (BMC Veterinary Research)
pubmed-fyfe-2018-komondor-cubn-cobalamin.note: Peer-reviewed molecular genetics study by Fyfe et al. (BMC Vet Res 2018;14(1):418, PMID 30591068, PMC6309081) identifying an autosomal-recessive CUBN intron 55 splice-donor variant (NM_001003148.1: c.8746+1G>A) causing inherited selective intestinal cobalamin (vitamin B12) malabsorption (Imerslund-Gräsbeck syndrome) in Komondors, with mutant allele frequencies of 8.3% in North America and 4.5% in Hungary, and recommending pre-breeding DNA screening.

wikimedia-komondor-img-0329-kuosa.name: Wikimedia Commons - File:Komondor IMG 0329.JPG
wikimedia-komondor-img-0329-kuosa.note: High-resolution photograph (3456 x 2304 px) of an adult Komondor outdoors by Kari Kuosa (EXIF capture date 2007-05-05, summary notes 2007-04-27, uploaded 2007-05-27). Licensed under CC BY-SA 3.0 Unported (also CC BY 2.5 and GFDL) on Wikimedia Commons.

wikimedia-komondor-laitinen.name: Wikimedia Commons - File:Komondor.jpg
wikimedia-komondor-laitinen.note: Photograph (450 x 300 px) of a mature corded Komondor standing on grass by Katri Laitinen / Hvitaharen (captured 2005-08-13, uploaded to Wikimedia Commons by Nironen on 2005-12-28). Licensed under CC BY-SA 3.0 Unported (and GFDL) on Wikimedia Commons.

natureserve-canis-lupus-familiaris.name: NatureServe Explorer - Canis familiaris / Canis lupus familiaris (ITIS TSN 726821)
natureserve-canis-lupus-familiaris.note: Authoritative biodiversity taxonomy record documenting the domestic dog as Canis lupus familiaris Linnaeus, 1758 (ITIS TSN 726821; Wilson & Reeder 2005) and Canis familiaris (ASM Mammal Diversity Database 2025).

rkc-briard-breed-profile.name: The Royal Kennel Club - Briard Breeds A to Z
rkc-briard-breed-profile.note: Official Royal Kennel Club breed profile covering breed characteristics (Large, more than 2 hours daily exercise, daily grooming, lifespan over 10 years), history (1863 first French dog show, 1897 recognition, WWI/WWII), pre-breeding health screening (genetic diversity, CSNB DNA, BVA/KC Hip Scheme), and Jan 6, 2025 import/overseas-sire CSNB registration restriction.

bca-briard-ofa-chic.name: Briard Club of America - OFA/CHIC Recommended Health Tests
bca-briard-ofa-chic.note: Official Briard Club of America CHIC program page detailing required screenings (OFA/PennHIP/International hip evaluation at min age 24 months, ACVO eye exam between 6 months and 8 years, and CSNB DNA test) plus optional recommended screenings (autoimmune thyroiditis panel FT4D/cTSH/TgAA and OFA elbow evaluation).

fci-cao-fila-de-sao-miguel-official-stan.name: FCI - Cão Fila de São Miguel (Saint Miguel Cattle Dog) Official Breed Standard No. 340
fci-cao-fila-de-sao-miguel-official-stan.note: Official English FCI Standard No. 340 (valid standard dated 2007-05-21, English publication dated 2007-06-20). Covers Portuguese origin on São Miguel Island in the Azores, 'Cow Dog' nickname, Terceira Dog historical link, Group 2 Section 2.1 Molossoid Dogue-type classification without working trial, low-biting dairy cattle working style, short harsh always-brindled coat, slight rear rolling gait, withers height (males 50-60 cm, females 48-58 cm), and weight (males 25-35 kg, females 20-30 kg).

fci-cao-fila-de-sao-miguel-nomenclature.name: FCI - Cão Fila de São Miguel Breed Nomenclature (No. 340)
fci-cao-fila-de-sao-miguel-nomenclature.note: Official FCI breed nomenclature record confirming Portugal as country of origin, Group 2 Section 2.1 Molossoid classification without working trial, provisional acceptance date (1995-03-10), definitive acceptance date (2007-05-21), and official multilingual names (Cão Fila de São Miguel, Saint Miguel Cattle Dog, Fila de Saint Miguel).

azores-agriculture-cao-fila-de-sao-migue.name: Portal da Agricultura dos Açores - Cão de Fila de São Miguel (Recursos Genéticos)
azores-agriculture-cao-fila-de-sao-migue.note: Official Regional Directorate of Agriculture of the Azores (Governo dos Açores) animal genetic-resources page for Cão de Fila de São Miguel, documenting native breed conservation alongside the Clube do Cão de Fila de São Miguel in Ponta Delgada.
azores-agriculture-cao-fila-de-sao-migue.publisher: Direção Regional da Agricultura dos Açores

ria-horter-cao-fila-de-sao-miguel-2013.name: Ria Hörter - Cão Fila de São Miguel aka Saint Miguel Cattle Dog (Canine Chronicle)
ria-horter-cao-fila-de-sao-miguel-2013.note: Published breed history article by Ria Hörter (Canine Chronicle Annual 2012-2013, published online 2013-01-10) documenting Azorean cattle-driving heritage, Azores Cattle Dog English name, the 1991 founding of the Clube do Cão de Fila de São Miguel, and the 1992 Ponta Delgada breed show featuring 70 Filas.

wikimedia-fila-de-sao-miguel-5-helsinki-.name: Wikimedia Commons - File:Fila de São Miguel 5 - Helsinki 6 Dec 2015.JPG
wikimedia-fila-de-sao-miguel-5-helsinki-.note: High-resolution photograph (1600 x 1200 px) of an adult brindle Cão Fila de São Miguel at the Finnish Winner 2015 show in Helsinki by Yulia Petrova / Томасина (EXIF capture date 2015-12-06, uploaded 2015-12-18). Licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 International on Wikimedia Commons.

wikimedia-rzeszow-cao-fila-de-sao-miguel.name: Wikimedia Commons - File:Rzeszów Cão Fila de São Miguel 3pl.jpg
wikimedia-rzeszow-cao-fila-de-sao-miguel.note: High-resolution photograph (1964 x 1728 px) of an adult brindle Cão Fila de São Miguel at the International Dog Show in Rzeszów, Poland, by Pleple2000 (captured 2011-02-19, uploaded 2011-02-27). Licensed under CC BY-SA 3.0 Unported (multi-licensed with 2.5/2.0/1.0 and GFDL) on Wikimedia Commons.

akc-anatolian-shepherd-dog-breed-standar.name: American Kennel Club - Official Standard of the Anatolian Shepherd Dog
akc-anatolian-shepherd-dog-breed-standar.note: Official AKC breed standard (Working Group; approved June 1995, effective June 1, 1996). Establishes minimum height at age 2+ (dogs from 29 inches, bitches from 27 inches, no upper limit), weight (dogs 110-150 pounds, bitches 80-120 pounds), rectangular build, protective neck ruff, V-shaped drop ears (4x6 in), low/wheel tail carriage, short-to-rough double coat (1-4 inches), all colours equally acceptable, and calm, instinctively protective temperament.

akc-anatolian-shepherd-dog-breed-profile.name: American Kennel Club - Anatolian Shepherd Dog Breed Information
akc-anatolian-shepherd-dog-breed-profile.note: Official AKC breed profile covering ancient Turkish livestock-guardian lineage, height (29 in male, 27 in female), weight (110-150 lb male, 80-120 lb female), life expectancy (11-13 years), double-coat shedding, and reserved, independent, loyal temperament.

asdca-anatolian-shepherd-facts.name: Anatolian Shepherd Dog Club of America (ASDCA) - Facts at a Glance
asdca-anatolian-shepherd-facts.note: Official US parent breed club resource documenting rural Turkey and Asia Minor origin, 1970 club founding, 11-13 year lifespan, slow 3-4 year maturity, conservative adult appetite, mandatory 5-6 foot locked fencing, quiet adult barking habits, strong pet dominance (two males typically incompatible), entropion in some lines, and anesthetic sensitivity.
asdca-anatolian-shepherd-facts.publisher: Anatolian Shepherd Dog Club of America

ofa-anatolian-shepherd-chic-requirements.name: Orthopedic Foundation for Animals - Anatolian Shepherd CHIC Requirements
ofa-anatolian-shepherd-chic-requirements.note: Official OFA Canine Health Information Center (CHIC) testing requirements for the Anatolian Shepherd Dog (ANS), requiring radiographic Hip Dysplasia evaluation (OFA, PennHIP, or recognized foreign registry) and OFA Elbow Dysplasia evaluation.

ccf-livestock-guarding-dog-program.name: Cheetah Conservation Fund - The Year of the Livestock Guarding Dog
ccf-livestock-guarding-dog-program.note: Official Cheetah Conservation Fund report by Dr. Laurie Marker documenting the placement of over 650 Anatolian Shepherd / Kangal livestock guarding dogs across Namibia, South Africa, and Tanzania since the 1990s to protect livestock non-lethally and reduce cheetah conflict.

wikimedia-anatolian-shepherd-dog-mountjo.name: Wikimedia Commons - File:Anatolian Shepherd Dog.jpg
wikimedia-anatolian-shepherd-dog-mountjo.note: High-resolution photograph (5184 x 3456 px) of an adult fawn Anatolian Shepherd Dog with black mask by Jon Mountjoy (captured 2010-11-06, uploaded to Wikimedia Commons via Flickr upload bot by Ltshears on 2012-08-06). Licensed under CC BY 2.0 Generic.

wikimedia-anatolian-shepherd-dog-01-cebe.name: Wikimedia Commons - File:Anatolian Shepherd Dog 01.jpg
wikimedia-anatolian-shepherd-dog-01-cebe.note: High-resolution photograph (4250 x 2833 px) of a female Anatolian Shepherd Dog in Karataş, Adana, Turkey, by Zeynel Cebeci / Zcebeci (EXIF capture date 2020-06-07, uploaded 2020-06-09). Licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 International on Wikimedia Commons.

rkc-weimaraner-breed-profile.name: The Royal Kennel Club - Weimaraner Breeds A to Z
rkc-weimaraner-breed-profile.note: Official Royal Kennel Club breed profile covering breed characteristics (Large, more than 2 hours daily exercise, once-weekly grooming, short & long coat varieties, lifespan over 10 years), accepted vs. non-standard colors (Mouse/Roe/Silver Grey vs. NBS Blue), and Best Practice health schemes (BVA/KC Hip, BVA/KC Elbow, BVA/KC/ISDS Eye).

weimaraner-spinal-dysraphism-nkx2-8-2013.name: Genome-Wide Association Mapping in Dogs Enables Identification of NKX2-8 in Neural Tube Defects (PLoS Genet 2013)
weimaraner-spinal-dysraphism-nkx2-8-2013.note: Peer-reviewed genetics study (Safra et al., PLoS Genet 2013;9(7):e1003646, PMID 23874236) identifying a G-to-AA frameshift mutation in exon 2 of the NKX2-8 homeobox gene on canine chromosome 8 causing spinal dysraphism in Weimaraners.

weimaraner-hypomyelination-fnip2-2014.name: A Mutation in the Canine Gene Encoding Folliculin-Interacting Protein 2 (FNIP2) Associated with Disruption in Spinal Cord Myelination (Glia 2014)
weimaraner-hypomyelination-fnip2-2014.note: Peer-reviewed neurogenetics study (Pemberton et al., Glia 2014 Jan;62(1):39-51, PMID 24272703) identifying an autosomal recessive frameshift mutation in FNIP2 on canine chromosome 15 causing hypomyelination ('shaking puppy' tremor syndrome) in Weimaraners.

rkc-curly-coated-retriever-breed-profile.name: The Royal Kennel Club - Retriever (Curly Coated) Breeds A to Z
rkc-curly-coated-retriever-breed-profile.note: Official Royal Kennel Club breed profile noting oldest and tallest retriever heritage, Vulnerable Native Breed status, Colour Watch Category 0 (Black, Liver), >2 hours/day exercise, and pre-breeding health screening (Good Practice: genetic diversity, BVA/KC Hip & Elbow schemes; Best Practice: EIC DNA test).

ccrca-curly-coated-retriever-breeders-he.name: Curly-Coated Retriever Club of America - Breeders and Health Testing Guidelines
ccrca-curly-coated-retriever-breeders-he.note: Official parent club pre-breeding health testing guidelines recommending OFA Hip or PennHIP (and OFA Elbow), CAER eye exam, OFA Heart echocardiogram by a board-certified cardiologist after age 2, and DNA tests for GSD Type IIIa, EIC, and CORD-1 PRA.

pubmed-gregory-2007-ccr-gsd3a.name: Gregory et al. (2007) - Glycogen storage disease type IIIa in curly-coated retrievers
pubmed-gregory-2007-ccr-gsd3a.note: Peer-reviewed study in Journal of Veterinary Internal Medicine (2007;21(1):40-46, PMID 17338148) establishing that GSD IIIa in Curly-Coated Retrievers is an autosomal recessive trait caused by a single adenosine deletion in exon 32 of the glycogen debranching enzyme gene (AGL).
pubmed-gregory-2007-ccr-gsd3a.publisher: Journal of Veterinary Internal Medicine (PubMed / NIH)

fci-irish-soft-coated-wheaten-terrier-of.name: FCI - Irish Soft Coated Wheaten Terrier Official Breed Standard No. 40
fci-irish-soft-coated-wheaten-terrier-of.note: Official English FCI Standard No. 40 (valid standard dated 2001-01-27, English publication dated 2001-04-25). Covers Irish origin, 1937 Irish Kennel Club recognition, Group 3 Section 1 Large and medium sized Terriers classification without working trial, tight black lips, soft silky wavy wheaten coat, puppy coat clearing, spirited affectionate temperament, and male height (18-19 inches / 46-48 cm; bitches somewhat less).

fci-irish-soft-coated-wheaten-terrier-no.name: FCI - Irish Soft Coated Wheaten Terrier Breed Nomenclature (No. 40)
fci-irish-soft-coated-wheaten-terrier-no.note: Official FCI breed nomenclature record confirming Ireland as country of origin, Group 3 Section 1 Large and medium sized Terriers classification without working trial, definitive acceptance date (1957-02-26), and official multilingual names (Irish Soft Coated Wheaten Terrier, Terrier Irlandais à Poil Doux).

akc-soft-coated-wheaten-terrier-breed-st.name: American Kennel Club - Official Standard of the Soft Coated Wheaten Terrier
akc-soft-coated-wheaten-terrier-breed-st.note: Official AKC breed standard (Terrier Group, approved August 10, 2009) establishing exact male and female height (dogs 18-19 inches, ideal 18.5; bitches 17-18 inches, ideal 17.5), weight (dogs 35-40 pounds; bitches 30-35 pounds), square proportions, single silky coat without undercoat, tight black lips, scissor/level bite, upright 90-degree tail carriage, and happy, steady, self-confident temperament.

akc-soft-coated-wheaten-terrier-breed-pr.name: American Kennel Club - Soft Coated Wheaten Terrier Dog Breed Information
akc-soft-coated-wheaten-terrier-breed-pr.note: Official AKC breed profile covering 1973 AKC recognition, Irish farm-terrier history, height (18-19 in male / 17-18 in female), weight (35-40 lb male / 30-35 lb female), life expectancy (12-14 years), low-shedding coat requiring diligent combing, city/country adaptability, and agreeable trainability.

scwtca-health-overview.name: Soft Coated Wheaten Terrier Club of America (SCWTCA) - Health Overview
scwtca-health-overview.note: Official US parent breed club health portal summarizing primary breed health conditions tracked in the SCWT Health & Pedigree Database: Protein-Losing Nephropathy (PLN), Protein-Losing Enteropathy (PLE) / IBD, Renal Dysplasia (RD), Addison's Disease, Incontinence / Ectopic Ureter, Microphthalmia & Eye Disorders, Degenerative Myelopathy (DM), and Paroxysmal Dyskinesia (PxD).
scwtca-health-overview.publisher: Soft Coated Wheaten Terrier Club of America

scwtca-breeding-health-testing.name: Soft Coated Wheaten Terrier Club of America (SCWTCA) - Health Testing Protocols for Breeding Stock
scwtca-breeding-health-testing.note: Official SCWTCA Code of Ethics & CHIC breeding health-testing protocol detailing required tests (Hip Certification, CAER Eye Certification, PLN Variant Gene Test) and recommended/optional DNA and orthopedic screenings (Microphthalmia, DM, Paroxysmal Dyskinesia, Patella, Elbow).
scwtca-breeding-health-testing.publisher: Soft Coated Wheaten Terrier Club of America

scwtca-annual-testing-protocols.name: Soft Coated Wheaten Terrier Club of America (SCWTCA) - Annual Testing Protocols
scwtca-annual-testing-protocols.note: Official SCWTCA annual veterinary screening guide recommending CBC, serum biochemistry, urinalysis, Urine Protein/Creatinine Ratio (UPC) or Microalbuminuria (MA), and blood pressure baseline checks, plus semi-annual proteinuria screening for dogs carrying one or two PLN-associated variant alleles.
scwtca-annual-testing-protocols.publisher: Soft Coated Wheaten Terrier Club of America

pubmed-littman-2013-scwt-nphs1-kirrel2-p.name: Glomerulopathy and mutations in NPHS1 and KIRREL2 in soft-coated Wheaten Terrier dogs (Mammalian Genome)
pubmed-littman-2013-scwt-nphs1-kirrel2-p.note: Peer-reviewed molecular genetics study by Littman et al. (Mamm Genome 2013;24(3-4):119-126, Epub 2013-01-17, PMID 23325127) identifying NPHS1 and KIRREL2 mutations strongly associated with familial Protein-Losing Nephropathy (PLN) in Soft Coated Wheaten Terriers (homozygous OR = 9.06; 95% CI 4.24-19.35)—the first molecular characterization of an inherited canine podocytopathy.

pubmed-kaukonen-2018-scwt-rbp4-microphth.name: Maternal Inheritance of a Recessive RBP4 Defect in Canine Congenital Eye Disease (Cell Reports)
pubmed-kaukonen-2018-scwt-rbp4-microphth.note: Peer-reviewed study by Kaukonen et al. (Cell Rep 2018;23(9):2643-2652, PMID 29847795) identifying an RBP4 deletion (c.282_284delGAA) causing bilateral microphthalmia, chorioretinal hypoplasia, and retinal colobomas in Irish Soft Coated Wheaten Terriers via a unique recessive maternal penetrance effect (manifesting only when both dam and offspring are homozygous, impairing placental vitamin A transport).

pubmed-kolicheski-2017-scwt-pign-pxd.name: A homozygous PIGN missense mutation in Soft-Coated Wheaten Terriers with a canine paroxysmal dyskinesia (Neurogenetics)
pubmed-kolicheski-2017-scwt-pign-pxd.note: Peer-reviewed study by Kolicheski et al. (Neurogenetics 2017;18(1):39-47, Epub 2016-11-28, PMID 27891564, PMC5243907) identifying a rare autosomal-recessive homozygous PIGN:c.398C>T missense mutation causing canine paroxysmal dyskinesia (median onset 2.25 years) in 25 affected Soft Coated Wheaten Terriers.

wikimedia-wheaten-terrier-01-claralieu.name: Wikimedia Commons - File:Wheaten Terrier 01.jpg
wikimedia-wheaten-terrier-01-claralieu.note: High-resolution photograph (3704 x 3036 px) of an adult Soft Coated Wheaten Terrier by claralieu / Art Prof (EXIF capture date 2022-04-02, uploaded to Wikimedia Commons by Ser Amantio di Nicolao on 2022-11-10, FlickreviewR 2 confirmed 2022-11-15). Licensed under CC BY 2.0 Generic.

wikimedia-soft-coated-wheaten-terrier-pl.name: Wikimedia Commons - File:Soft-coated wheaten terrier.jpg
wikimedia-soft-coated-wheaten-terrier-pl.note: High-resolution photograph (2604 x 1974 px) of an adult Soft Coated Wheaten Terrier at the Rybnik dog show by Pleple2000 (captured 2006-10-01, uploaded 2006-10-07). Licensed under CC BY-SA 3.0 Unported (multi-licensed with 2.5/2.0/1.0 and GFDL) on Wikimedia Commons.

pubmed-spanish-mastiff-leishmaniosis-202.name: Romero et al. (2024) - Exploring the impact of epidemiological and clinical factors on the progression of canine leishmaniosis by statistical and whole genome analyses
pubmed-spanish-mastiff-leishmaniosis-202.note: Peer-reviewed study in International Journal for Parasitology (2024 Jul;54(8-9):401-414, PMID 38570155) identifying the Spanish Mastiff among 20 breeds displaying a clinical resistance phenotype against severe Leishmania infantum infection.

spj-pohjanpystykorva-pevisa.name: Suomen Pystykorvajärjestö - Pohjanpystykorva PEVISA (2025-2029) & Breeding Guidelines
spj-pohjanpystykorva-pevisa.note: Official Finnish Spitz Club (SPJ) PEVISA program (valid 2025-01-01 to 2029-12-31) detailing mandatory pre-breeding patellar luxation and official eye exams (excluding hereditary cataracts, gRD, tRD, PRA, and PHTVL/PHPV grades 2-6), inbreeding limit (<=6.25% over 7 generations), 30-offspring lifetime cap, epilepsy epi-index monitoring, and hereditary ataxia carrier testing recommendations.

pubmed-kumpulainen-2017-nordic-spitz-div.name: Kumpulainen et al. (2017) - Founder representation and effective population size in old versus young breeds: genetic diversity of Finnish and Nordic Spitz
pubmed-kumpulainen-2017-nordic-spitz-div.note: Peer-reviewed study in Journal of Animal Breeding and Genetics (2017 Oct;134(5):422-433, PMID 28295678) demonstrating that despite small effective population size and near-extinction, Nordic Spitz maintains SNP heterozygosity (mean Hz = 0.409) comparable to mixed-breed dogs, supported by an open breed registry.
pubmed-kumpulainen-2017-nordic-spitz-div.publisher: Journal of Animal Breeding and Genetics (PubMed / NIH)

pubmed-fall-2008-gdm-nordic-spitz.name: Fall et al. (2008) - Gestational diabetes mellitus in 13 dogs
pubmed-fall-2008-gdm-nordic-spitz.note: Peer-reviewed retrospective study in Journal of Veterinary Internal Medicine (2008 Nov-Dec;22(6):1296-1300, PMID 18976285) finding Nordic Spitz breeds overrepresented (11 of 13 cases) among middle-aged pregnant bitches diagnosed with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM).
pubmed-fall-2008-gdm-nordic-spitz.publisher: Journal of Veterinary Internal Medicine (PubMed / NIH)

akc-plott-breed-standard.name: American Kennel Club - Official Standard of the Plott
akc-plott-breed-standard.note: Official AKC breed standard (Hound Group; approved June 1998, effective October 1, 1998). Establishes height at withers (males 20-25 inches, females 20-23 inches), weight in hunting condition (males 50-60 pounds, females 40-55 pounds), ear spread (18-20 in males, 17-19 in females), smooth glossy coat with rare double coats, brindle/solid black/saddle/buckskin colours, rump identification-mark allowance, disqualifications (bloodhound-like ears extending past nose; splayed feet), and bold, loyal temperament.

akc-plott-hound-breed-profile.name: American Kennel Club - Plott Hound Dog Breed Information
akc-plott-hound-breed-profile.note: Official AKC breed profile covering 1750 Johannes Plott and Henry Plott North Carolina history, Hanoverian Hound ancestry, 2006 AKC recognition, height (20-25 in male, 20-23 in female), weight (50-60 lb male, 40-55 lb female), life expectancy (12-14 years), low-to-moderate shedding, high barking/energy traits, hip dysplasia screening, and pendant ear-infection care.

ukc-plott-hound-breed-standard.name: United Kennel Club - Plott Hound Breed Standard
ukc-plott-hound-breed-standard.note: Official UKC breed standard (Scenthound Group, first recognized by UKC in 1946) confirming Plott Hound breed designation, conformation, brindle preference with solid black and limited chest/feet white allowance, and rugged working hound temperament.

nc-history-plott-hound-state-dog.name: North Carolina History Project - Plott Hound: The State Dog
nc-history-plott-hound-state-dog.note: Historical encyclopedia entry by Jessica Lee Thompson documenting the Plott Hound's North Carolina heritage, 1989 designation by the North Carolina General Assembly as Official State Dog, and the 2009 North Carolina Highway Historical Marker in Waynesville.

pubmed-spellacy-1983-plott-hound-mps1.name: A canine model of human alpha-L-iduronidase deficiency (PNAS 1983)
pubmed-spellacy-1983-plott-hound-mps1.note: Peer-reviewed landmark study by Spellacy et al. (Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A 1983 Oct;80(19):6091-6095, PMID 6412235) describing autosomal-recessive alpha-L-iduronidase deficiency (Mucopolysaccharidosis Type I / MPS I, resembling human Hurler-Scheie syndrome) discovered in three Plott Hound littermates.
pubmed-spellacy-1983-plott-hound-mps1.publisher: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences / PubMed

pubmed-menon-1992-canine-idua-mps1.name: Architecture of the canine IDUA gene and mutation underlying canine mucopolysaccharidosis I (Genomics 1992)
pubmed-menon-1992-canine-idua-mps1.note: Peer-reviewed molecular genetics study by Menon, Tieu, and Neufeld (Genomics 1992 Nov;14(3):763-768, PMID 1339393) identifying the canine IDUA splice-site mutation causing retention of intron 1 and a premature termination codon underlying canine Mucopolysaccharidosis I (MPS I) in the Plott Hound lineage.

wikimedia-plott-hound-emery.name: Wikimedia Commons - File:Plott Hound.jpg
wikimedia-plott-hound-emery.note: High-resolution photograph (2658 x 1771 px) of an adult brindle Plott Hound by James Emery (captured 2008-12-26 on Canon PowerShot A630, originally published on Flickr ID 3154571815, uploaded to Wikimedia Commons by Ltshears via Flickr upload bot on 2012-07-18). Licensed under CC BY 2.0 Generic.

wikimedia-plotthound-brindle1-canarian.name: Wikimedia Commons - File:Plotthound-brindle1.jpg
wikimedia-plotthound-brindle1-canarian.note: High-resolution profile photograph (1973 x 1664 px) of a brindle Plott Hound by Canarian (EXIF capture date 2022-12-02, uploaded 2022-12-08). Licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 International on Wikimedia Commons.

fci-bavarian-mountain-scent-hound-offici.name: FCI - Bavarian Mountain Scent Hound (Bayerischer Gebirgsschweisshund) Official Breed Standard No. 217
fci-bavarian-mountain-scent-hound-offici.note: Official English FCI Standard No. 217 (valid standard dated 2017-08-22, English publication dated 2017-09-22). Covers German origin in Bavaria (post-1870 Baron Karg-Bebenburg cross of Hanoverian and red Mountain Scenthounds, 1912 Munich club), Group 6 Section 2 Leash (scent) Hounds classification with working trial, 1:1.15-1:1.25 body proportions, spoon-shaped feet, 'Bracken Star' chest patch, dense moderately harsh red/fawn/deer-grey coat, strict withers height (males 47-52 cm, females 44-48 cm, no departure permitted), and ideal weight (males 20-30 kg, females 17-25 kg).

fci-bavarian-mountain-scent-hound-nomenc.name: FCI - Bayerischer Gebirgsschweisshund Breed Nomenclature (No. 217)
fci-bavarian-mountain-scent-hound-nomenc.note: Official FCI breed nomenclature record confirming Germany as country of origin, Group 6 Section 2 Leash (scent) Hounds classification subject to a working trial, definitive recognition date (1959-11-14), and official multilingual names (Bayerischer Gebirgsschweisshund, Bavarian Mountain Scent Hound, Chien de Rouge de Bavière).

akc-bavarian-mountain-scent-hound-breed-.name: American Kennel Club - Bavarian Mountain Scent Hound Dog Breed Information
akc-bavarian-mountain-scent-hound-breed-.note: Official AKC breed profile (Foundation Stock Service) documenting German origin, height (17-20.5 inches), weight (37-66 pounds), life expectancy (12-15 years), moderate shedding, low grooming (2/5), trainability (4/5), quiet barking level (2/5), and loyal, reserved-with-strangers temperament.

bmhs-gb-hip-dysplasia.name: Bavarian Mountain Hound Society of Great Britain - Hip Dysplasia
bmhs-gb-hip-dysplasia.note: Official UK breed society health resource explaining BVA/KC radiographic hip scoring for Bavarian Mountain Hounds aged one year or older, reporting a breed mean score of approximately 10 (range 4-20+) and advising breeding from hounds scoring below the breed mean.
bmhs-gb-hip-dysplasia.publisher: Bavarian Mountain Hound Society of Great Britain

bmhs-gb-epilepsy.name: Bavarian Mountain Hound Society of Great Britain - Epilepsy
bmhs-gb-epilepsy.note: Official UK breed society health page documenting inherited idiopathic epilepsy in Bavarian Mountain Hound bloodlines (typically emerging between 1 and 5 years of age), pedigree-based prevention, and participation in canine epilepsy genetics research.
bmhs-gb-epilepsy.publisher: Bavarian Mountain Hound Society of Great Britain

wikimedia-bavarian-mountain-scenthound-c.name: Wikimedia Commons - File:Bavarian Mountain Scenthound.jpg
wikimedia-bavarian-mountain-scenthound-c.note: High-resolution photograph (1709 x 1415 px) of an adult Bavarian Mountain Scenthound in profile by Canarian (EXIF capture date 2017-12-09, uploaded 2018-01-27). Licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 International on Wikimedia Commons.

wikimedia-deer-red-bavarian-mountain-hou.name: Wikimedia Commons - File:Deer Red Bavarian Mountain Hound.jpg
wikimedia-deer-red-bavarian-mountain-hou.note: High-resolution photograph (3264 x 2448 px) of a two-year-old deer-red female Bavarian Mountain Hound by Antham1616 (EXIF capture date 2019-08-22, uploaded 2019-08-22). Licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 International on Wikimedia Commons.

rkc-rhodesian-ridgeback-breed-profile.name: The Royal Kennel Club - Rhodesian Ridgeback Breeds A to Z
rkc-rhodesian-ridgeback-breed-profile.note: Official Royal Kennel Club breed profile covering southern African lion-tracking heritage and Good Practice pre-breeding health tests (DNA test for Juvenile Myoclonic Epilepsy [JME], BVA/KC Elbow Dysplasia Scheme, and BVA/KC Hip Dysplasia Scheme).

pubmed-wielaender-2017-rr-jme-diras1.name: Wielaender et al. (2017) - Generalized myoclonic epilepsy with photosensitivity in juvenile dogs caused by a defective DIRAS family GTPase 1
pubmed-wielaender-2017-rr-jme-diras1.note: Peer-reviewed study in PNAS (2017 Mar 7;114(10):2669-2674, PMID 28223533) identifying a fully penetrant recessive 4-bp deletion in DIRAS1 causing Juvenile Myoclonic Epilepsy (JME) with photosensitivity in young Rhodesian Ridgebacks (onset 6 weeks to 18 months).
pubmed-wielaender-2017-rr-jme-diras1.publisher: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences (PubMed / NIH)

pubmed-eoad-2022-rr-eps8l2.name: Early onset adult deafness in the Rhodesian Ridgeback dog is associated with an in-frame deletion in the EPS8L2 gene (PLoS One 2022)
pubmed-eoad-2022-rr-eps8l2.note: Peer-reviewed GWAS study in PLoS One (2022 Apr 6;17(4):e0264365, PMID 35385474) identifying an autosomal recessive 12-bp in-frame deletion in EPS8L2 strongly associated with Early Onset Adult Deafness (EOAD) in Rhodesian Ridgebacks.

fci-sarplaninac-official-standard.name: FCI - Yugoslavian Shepherd Dog - Sharplanina (Jugoslovenski Ovčarski Pas - Šarplaninac) Official Breed Standard No. 41
fci-sarplaninac-official-standard.note: Official English FCI Standard No. 41 (original valid standard 1970-11-24; English publication dated 1980-10-03 / PDF header 1980-10-31). Covers Šar Mountains origin, Group 2 Section 2.2 Mountain-type Molossoids classification without working trial, 1939 Ilirski Ovčar registration and 1957 renaming, average height (males 62 cm, females 58 cm; breeding minimums 56 cm males, 54 cm females), weight (males 35-45 kg, females 30-40 kg), body proportions, tight dewlap-free skin, 10-12 cm withers coat, solid colours (iron grey / dark grey preferred), and incorruptible guardian character.

fci-sarplaninac-nomenclature.name: FCI - Jugoslovenski Ovčarski Pas - Šarplaninac Breed Nomenclature (No. 41)
fci-sarplaninac-nomenclature.note: Official FCI breed nomenclature record confirming North Macedonia and Serbia as countries of origin, Group 2 Section 2.2 classification without working trial, definitive recognition date (1957-07-24), and official multilingual names (Yugoslavian Shepherd Dog - Sharplanina, Chien de Berger Yougoslave de Charplanina).

ukc-sarplaninac-breed-standard.name: United Kennel Club - Sarplaninac Breed Standard
ukc-sarplaninac-breed-standard.note: Official UKC breed standard (Guardian Dog Group, recognized 1995) confirming Sarplaninac breed designation, mountain livestock-guardian build, and independent, calm, fearless temperament.

skk-sarplaninac-breed-profile.name: Svenska Kennelklubben (SKK) - Sarplaninac Rasprofil
skk-sarplaninac-breed-profile.note: Official Swedish Kennel Club (SKK) breed profile for Sarplaninac confirming North Macedonia and Serbia origin, sharp attentive guarding with loud persistent barking, experienced-owner responsibility warning, relatively easy-care double coat brushed during shedding, and documentation that hip dysplasia (HD) occurs while Swedish numbers remain too small for full national statistics.

scc-sarplaninac-breed-profile.name: Société Centrale Canine (SCC) - Chien de berger yougoslave de Charplanina
scc-sarplaninac-breed-profile.note: Official French Kennel Club (SCC) breed profile detailing calm discreet home demeanour, stranger suspicion, respectful 'iron hand in a velvet glove' training philosophy, unsuitability for sedentary city life, modest adult food intake, and balanced puppy-growth nutrition.

pubmed-ceh-dovc-2014-western-balkan-lgd-.name: Population structure and genetic differentiation of livestock guard dog breeds from the Western Balkans (J Anim Breed Genet 2014)
pubmed-ceh-dovc-2014-western-balkan-lgd-.note: Peer-reviewed molecular population-genetics study by Ceh and Dovc (University of Ljubljana; J Anim Breed Genet 2014 Aug;131(4):313-325, Epub 2014-01-08, PMID 24397417) analyzing nuclear microsatellites and mtDNA across Sarplaninac (n = 109), Karst Shepherd, and Tornjak, documenting high nuclear genetic diversity (H = 0.770), highest mtDNA haplotype diversity including a unique haplotype, and low inbreeding in the Sarplaninac.
pubmed-ceh-dovc-2014-western-balkan-lgd-.publisher: Journal of Animal Breeding and Genetics / PubMed

pmc-katz-2017-canine-ncl-review.name: Canine neuronal ceroid lipofuscinoses: Promising models for preclinical testing of therapeutic interventions (Neurobiol Dis / PMC5675811)
pmc-katz-2017-canine-ncl-review.note: Peer-reviewed comparative review (PMID 28860089, PMC5675811) noting an isolated historical case report of neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis in a Yugoslavian Shepherd Dog without established breed-wide prevalence or an identified causal mutation.

wikimedia-sarplaninac-muri-emir-sakal33.name: Wikimedia Commons - File:Sarplaninac male dog Muri-Emír 2 years old.jpg
wikimedia-sarplaninac-muri-emir-sakal33.note: High-resolution photograph (5184 x 3456 px) of a two-year-old iron-grey male Šarplaninac by Sakal33 (EXIF capture date 2020-04-13, uploaded 2020-04-14). Licensed under CC BY-SA 3.0 Unported on Wikimedia Commons.

wikimedia-sarplaninac-ruma-serbia-orjen.name: Wikimedia Commons - File:Šarplaninac in Ruma Serbia.jpg
wikimedia-sarplaninac-ruma-serbia-orjen.note: High-resolution photograph (4032 x 3024 px) of an adult Šarplaninac in Ruma, Serbia, by Orjen (EXIF capture date 2015-04-11, uploaded 2019-03-22). Licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 International on Wikimedia Commons.

fci-catalan-sheepdog-official-standard.name: FCI - Catalan Sheepdog (Gos d'Atura Català) Official Breed Standard No. 87
fci-catalan-sheepdog-official-standard.note: Official English FCI Standard No. 87 (valid standard dated 1982-05-26, English publication dated 2004-09-13). Covers Spanish origin in the Catalan Pyrenees, Group 1 Section 1 Sheepdogs classification without working trial, 9:8 body ratio, 4:3 skull-to-muzzle ratio, black lips and palate, 8:10 ear ratio, long/short (<10 cm)/tailless tail variations, hind double bony dewclaws joined by membrane, two-stage front-then-hind moult, blended coat colours (fawn, sable, grey, frosty black), all-weather resistance, frugal diet, and withers height (males 47-55 cm, females 45-53 cm). Omits weight.

fci-catalan-sheepdog-nomenclature.name: FCI - Gos d'Atura Català (Catalan Sheepdog) Breed Nomenclature (No. 87)
fci-catalan-sheepdog-nomenclature.note: Official FCI breed nomenclature record confirming Spain as country of origin, Group 1 Section 1 Sheepdogs classification without working trial, definitive acceptance date (1954-11-30), and official multilingual names (Gos d'Atura Català, Catalan Sheepdog, Chien de Berger Catalan, Perro de Pastor Catalán).

rkc-catalan-sheepdog-breed-standard.name: The Royal Kennel Club - Catalan Sheepdog Breed Standard
rkc-catalan-sheepdog-breed-standard.note: Official Royal Kennel Club breed standard (Pastoral Group, published 2025-04-01) confirming 9:8 body proportions, 4:3 skull-to-muzzle ratio, close-fitting black lips and palate, dark tongue patches allowance, mandatory hind double dewclaws, ideal height (dogs 47-55 cm, bitches 45-53 cm), coat colours, and alert, loyal, trainable family temperament.

rkc-catalan-sheepdog-breed-profile.name: The Royal Kennel Club - Catalan Sheepdog Breed Information
rkc-catalan-sheepdog-breed-profile.note: Official Royal Kennel Club Breeds A to Z profile for Catalan Sheepdog documenting northeastern Spanish Pyrenees origin, medium size, small-house and small/medium-garden suitability, weekly grooming, low free shedding, Breed Watch Category 1 status, and Best Practice health screenings (BVA/KC/ISDS Eye Scheme and BVA/KC Hip Dysplasia Scheme).

skk-gos-datura-catala-breed-profile.name: Svenska Kennelklubben (SKK) - Gos d'atura catalá Rasprofil
skk-gos-datura-catala-breed-profile.note: Official Swedish Kennel Club (SKK) breed profile for Gos d'atura catalá documenting 1929 official recognition, Catalan Pyrenees origin, height (47-55 cm males, 45-53 cm females), approximate weight (ca 19-22 kg), weekly combing with no clipping required, active dog-sport versatility, lingering guarding instincts, and small-population health data limitations.

scc-chien-de-berger-catalan-profile.name: Société Centrale Canine (SCC) - Chien de berger catalan
scc-chien-de-berger-catalan-profile.note: Official French Kennel Club (SCC) breed profile for Chien de berger catalan (Gos d'atura / Perro de pastor catalán) documenting Catalonian heritage, Spanish Civil War messenger and sentry role, height (45-55 cm), approximate weight (environ 18 kg), and coat colour varieties.

cscogb-catalan-sheepdog-health.name: The Catalan Sheepdog Club of Great Britain - Health & Welfare
cscogb-catalan-sheepdog-health.note: Official UK parent breed club health page (updated February 2026) recommending pre-breeding BVA/KC Hip Dysplasia scoring (reporting a 15-year median hip score of 11 as of 31 December 2024) and BVA/KC/ISDS specialist eye testing for hereditary eye diseases including Progressive Retinal Atrophy (PRA).
cscogb-catalan-sheepdog-health.publisher: The Catalan Sheepdog Club of Great Britain

wikimedia-katalansk-gjeterhund-elinandre.name: Wikimedia Commons - File:Katalansk gjeterhund.jpg
wikimedia-katalansk-gjeterhund-elinandre.note: High-resolution photograph (5184 x 3456 px) of an adult Catalan Sheepdog by Elinandreassen (EXIF capture date 2012-02-26 on Canon EOS 7D, uploaded 2013-04-30). Licensed under CC BY-SA 3.0 Unported on Wikimedia Commons.

wikimedia-gos-d-atura-catala-caronna.name: Wikimedia Commons - File:Gos-d'Atura-Catala.jpg
wikimedia-gos-d-atura-catala-caronna.note: Photograph (1189 x 966 px) of an adult Catalan Sheepdog standing outdoors in profile by Caronna (EXIF capture date 2005-04-24, uploaded 2005-04-24). Licensed under CC BY-SA 3.0 Unported (and GFDL) on Wikimedia Commons.

rkc-whippet-breed-profile.name: The Royal Kennel Club - Whippet Breeds A to Z
rkc-whippet-breed-profile.note: Official Royal Kennel Club Breeds A to Z profile covering genetic ancestry linked to the Greyhound (Celtic Vertragus), 19th-century mining-area history across northern England, Wales, London, and the Midlands, and recognized coat colors.

pubmed-whippet-mvd-gwas-2015.name: Severity of Mitral Valve Degeneration Is Associated with Chromosome 15 Loci in Whippet Dogs (PLoS One 2015)
pubmed-whippet-mvd-gwas-2015.note: Peer-reviewed genome-wide association study (Stern et al., PLoS One 2015;10(10):e0141234, PMID 26509595) in 138 Whippets identifying a genome-wide significant locus on canine chromosome 15 (near FSTL5) associated with mitral valve degeneration severity.

fci-serbian-hound-official-standard.name: FCI - Serbian Hound (Srpski gonič) Official Breed Standard No. 150
fci-serbian-hound-official-standard.note: Official English FCI Standard No. 150 (valid standard dated 2003-03-25, English publication dated 2003-05-05). Covers Serbian origin, Group 6 Section 1.2 Medium-sized Hounds classification with working trial, proportions (body +10%, chest girth +20%, head 45%, muzzle:skull 9:10), short glossy fox-red coat with black saddle/mantle and temple marks (max 2 cm round white chest spot), kind/lively/tenacious temperament, and withers height (males 46-56 cm, ideal 51-52 cm; females 44-54 cm, ideal 48-49 cm). Omits weight.

fci-serbian-hound-nomenclature.name: FCI - Srpski Gonič (Serbian Hound) Breed Nomenclature (No. 150)
fci-serbian-hound-nomenclature.note: Official FCI breed nomenclature record confirming Serbia as country of origin, Group 6 Section 1.2 Medium-sized Hounds classification with working trial, definitive acceptance date (1955-03-30), and official multilingual names (Srpski gonič, Serbian Hound, Chien Courant Serbe).

kss-srpski-gonic-standard.name: Kinološki savez Republike Srbije (KSS) - Standard za Srpskog goniča (FCI 150)
kss-srpski-gonic-standard.note: Official Kennel Club of the Republic of Serbia (KSS) publication of FCI Standard No. 150 for Srpski gonič documenting Serbian origin, 1905 Franz Laska description as Balkanski gonič, 1924 first standard, November 12, 1996 Copenhagen name change to Serbian Hound, complete conformation, disqualifying faults, and height specifications without a numerical weight range.

scc-chien-courant-serbe-profile.name: Société Centrale Canine (SCC) - Chien courant serbe
scc-chien-courant-serbe-profile.note: Official French Kennel Club (SCC) breed profile for Chien courant serbe (Balkanski gonič / Srpski gonič) confirming height (males 46-56 cm, females 44-54 cm), unsexed approximate weight note ('Jusqu'à 20 kg'), historical summary (1905 Franz Laska, 1924 standard, 1940 Bled adoption, 1996 renaming), and short dense glossy coat.

skk-srpski-gonic-breed-profile.name: Svenska Kennelklubben (SKK) - Srpski gonič Rasprofil
skk-srpski-gonic-breed-profile.note: Official Swedish Kennel Club (SKK) breed profile for Srpski gonič documenting Serbian origin, height (46-56 cm males, 44-54 cm females), easy-care short glossy coat, friendly lively enduring hunting temperament, need for hunting/field outlets rather than purely family-pet life, and note that small registered numbers in Sweden preclude reliable breed-wide health assessment.

pmc-katica-2025-balkan-dogs-amy2b.name: Copy number variations in AMY2B gene and amylase activity in Balkan dog breeds (PLOS ONE / PMC12047765)
pmc-katica-2025-balkan-dogs-amy2b.note: Peer-reviewed study by Katica et al. (University of Sarajevo, PLOS ONE 2025, PMC12047765) examining AMY2B diploid copy numbers, serum amylase activity, and serum glucose across eight native Balkan dog breeds including the Serbian Hound (SRP).
pmc-katica-2025-balkan-dogs-amy2b.publisher: PLOS ONE / National Library of Medicine (PMC)

wikimedia-serbian-hound-1-firkingreat.name: Wikimedia Commons - File:Serbian hound 1.jpg
wikimedia-serbian-hound-1-firkingreat.note: Photograph (662 x 580 px) of a Serbian Hound standing in a field by Firkingreat (captured and uploaded 2025-03-09). Dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0 on Wikimedia Commons.

wikimedia-serbian-hound-dog-running-firk.name: Wikimedia Commons - File:Serbian hound dog running.jpg
wikimedia-serbian-hound-dog-running-firk.note: High-resolution action photograph (1080 x 720 px) of a Serbian Hound running outdoors by Firkingreat (captured and uploaded 2025-03-13). Licensed under CC BY 4.0 International on Wikimedia Commons.

rkc-fox-terrier-smooth-breed-profile.name: The Royal Kennel Club - Fox Terrier (Smooth) Breeds A to Z
rkc-fox-terrier-smooth-breed-profile.note: Official Royal Kennel Club Breeds A to Z profile covering English fox-hunting history, Old English White Terrier/Bull Terrier/Beagle ancestry, 1862 Islington and 1863 Birmingham shows (Old Jock, Old Tartar, Old Trap), 1876 Fox Terrier Club of England standard, and health testing guidance.

rkc-bolognese-breed-profile.name: The Royal Kennel Club - Bolognese Breeds A to Z
rkc-bolognese-breed-profile.note: Official Royal Kennel Club Breeds A to Z profile confirming Bologna origin, untrimmed white flocky coat, White-only standard colour (Category 0), and Breed Watch status (no points of concern).

fci-styrian-coarse-haired-hound-official.name: FCI - Coarse-haired Styrian Hound (Steirische Rauhhaarbracke) Official Breed Standard No. 62
fci-styrian-coarse-haired-hound-official.note: Official English FCI Standard No. 62 (valid standard dated 1995-10-10, English publication dated 1996-06-18). Covers Austrian origin in Styria (1870 Carl Peintinger crossing Hanoverian Scenthound bitch 'Hela 1' with a coarse-haired Istrian Hound), Group 6 Section 1.2 Medium-sized hounds classification with working trial, weatherproof rough matte red or fawn coat with moustache (optional white chest mark), non-pendant lips, 42-tooth scissor bite (max two PM1/PM2 missing tolerated), and withers height (overall 45-53 cm; males 47-53 cm, females 45-51 cm). Omits weight.

fci-styrian-coarse-haired-hound-nomencla.name: FCI - Steirische Rauhhaarbracke (Coarse-haired Styrian Hound) Breed Nomenclature (No. 62)
fci-styrian-coarse-haired-hound-nomencla.note: Official FCI breed nomenclature record confirming Austria as country of origin, Group 6 Section 1.2 Medium-sized Hounds classification with working trial, definitive acceptance date (1954-08-31), and official multilingual names (Coarse-haired Styrian Hound, Brachet de Styrie à poil dur, Steirische Rauhhaarbracke, Sabueso Estirio de pelo áspero).

obv-steirische-rauhaarbracke-rasseportra.name: Österreichischer Brackenverein (ÖBV) - Rasseportrait Steirische Rauhaarbracke
obv-steirische-rauhaarbracke-rasseportra.note: Official Austrian parent breed club (Österreichischer Brackenverein) breed portrait for the Steirische Rauhaarbracke (Peintinger Bracke / Steirische Rauhaarige Hochgebirgsbracke), documenting its Austrian solo-hunting ('brackieren') use on hare, fox, badger, marten, and wild boar alongside wounded-game tracking ('Nachsuche').

obv-formulare-downloads-hd.name: Österreichischer Brackenverein (ÖBV) - Formulare & HD-Befundung Steirische Rauhhaarbracke
obv-formulare-downloads-hd.note: Official Austrian parent breed club breeding documentation portal publishing the dedicated radiographic Hip Dysplasia screening form ('HD Röntgenuntersuchung Steirische Rauhhaarbracke') and breeding/litter records.

skk-steirische-rauhhaarbracke-profile.name: Svenska Kennelklubben (SKK) - Steirische rauhhaarbracke Rasprofil
skk-steirische-rauhhaarbracke-profile.note: Official Swedish Kennel Club (SKK) breed profile for Steirische rauhhaarbracke confirming Austrian origin (1870 Carl Peintinger cross of Hanoverian Scenthound and Istarski oštrodlaki gonič), height (47-53 cm males, 45-51 cm females), no special coat grooming required, pronounced hunting temperament unsuited solely as a family pet, and note that small population numbers prevent broad breed-wide health evaluation.

scc-brachet-de-styrie-poil-dur-profile.name: Société Centrale Canine (SCC) - Brachet de Styrie à poil dur
scc-brachet-de-styrie-poil-dur-profile.note: Official French Kennel Club (SCC) breed profile for Brachet de Styrie à poil dur (Peintinger / Steirische Rauhhaarbracke) confirming height (47-53 cm males, 45-51 cm females), weight explicitly listed as unspecified (NP), and rough harsh coat details.
